news.title: 《Elden Ring》玩家正在努力测试新的玷污版 DLC 的装备
news.summary: Some poor bosses are getting "the Matador treatment".

content.v: Hand Elden Ring players a handful of new armor sets and weapons and they'll spend the next week or more experimenting and crunching the numbers to find out how they stack up against everything else in the legendary action RPG.
That is all that's been happening in the last few days since FromSoftware dropped the Tarnished Edition, a $5 DLC pack with new starting classes, armor sets, and horse armor .

It took a little while for people to figure out where to find everything added in the DLC. FromSoft did what FromSoft does and snuck them into places you wouldn't expect. But now that everyone feels like they've found it all, including some minor additions that weren't announced, the testing has begun.

By far the most popular new weapon is a greatsword you can steal from a new NPC who can show up for a duel. Leontiel's Greatsword is a direct reference to a character from Dark Souls 2 and comes with a powerful new move that mimics real life bullfighters, or matadors. When you use it, your character holds out a red cloth before stepping around your target and thrusting the sword into their back. It's easily one of the slickest animations in the game and, unsurprisingly, has players eager to see how it fairs against bosses.

Reddit user SaxSlaveGael put it to work on the one bull-like boss in the game, titling their post, "There's Only One Boss that truly deserves the Matador Treatment". When used on old Gaius in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC, the sword's Muleta skill works just like the real taunt that matadors do with the instrument it's named after. Gaius' boar was not ready for the feint and follow-up backstab. Is it the most efficient way to defeat the boss? Nope. Is it the sickest way to defeat the boss? Absolutely.

Another user, Ilamahradeys , took the sword for a spin against the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast at the center of a crater in Mt. Gelmir. Their character must've been pretty over-leveled because one jab with the sword knocked off almost the entire health bar, instantly staggering the rock-like creature. I won't lie: Watching a boss as resilient and annoying as the Fallingstar Beast get completely dunked on, with style, no less, was one of the most satisfying things I've seen all week.

You'd think that in a game as challenging as Elden Ring players would only ever use armor for practical reasons. But, as is tradition with these games, "fashion souls" is more important to some people than pure defense. And those players are in love with the shiny new chestpiece from the Idus starting class. It's a svelte, polished chestplate that blends with a lot of other sets in the game. One player has it on to cosplay Casca from Berserk , while another is too distracted by the buff it seems to give to your greatest asset .

Elden Ring also attracts the tryhards who need to know how viable all the new stuff is for their 90th playthrough. There's a Reddit user who blasted through the game as the new heavy armor class. They say it's a particularly sturdy class that takes some time to fully come into its own. It's boosted vigor (health) and strength stats—two things melee-focused characters tend to stack—help it shine in the mid-to-late game when the nastiest bosses start showing up.

All of this has me excited to start up a new Elden Ring playthrough myself. The Tarnished Edition isn't a game-changing DLC by any means, but it has just enough new toys to play with to make me want to get in there and mess around. We don't always get a neat little package like this for only $5 and it's probably just enough to keep me busy until the flood of September games begins.

news.title: Valve 向渴望下一次重大更新的《死锁》玩家保证，当更新准备就绪时，它将通知他们，“或者订购大量披萨”
news.summary: Yoshi said to expect the new big update by the end of September.

content.v: I don't envy Deadlock players who are dying to see the hybrid MOBA-shooter continue to grow in its pseudo-early access state. Valve is notoriously elusive when it comes to communication and has never made any promises to update it on a regular schedule.

This is the kind of uncertainty that drives Deadlock players to salivate over any new rumor or post by the developer-run Discord and forum account known as Yoshi. It's also what drives them to keep watch over the pizzerias near Valve's Seattle offices for spikes in visitors in the hopes that developers are lining up for grub as they finish the next major update.

This week, Deadlock players were hoping Valve would release its follow-up to the Old Gods, New Blood update , which added six new heroes to the game along with other major changes. Valve previously said a "large content update" was in the works alongside two other smaller updates to its ranked mode and items. But now that the ranked rework is out of the way, players were hoping to see another update before the end of the month.

According to a new post from Yoshi , the update is taking longer than expected. Yoshi doesn't specify if they're talking about the item update or the large content update—it almost implies they've been combined into one patch—but said it's going to have to wait until "late September."

"The delay is mainly due to the regular process of playtesting and iteration sometimes taking longer than expected, rather than a change in the scope of the update itself," they wrote. "We hope you will like the update when it comes out, and we'll make sure to give you a heads up (or order a ton of pizza) when things are a few days away or so."
Yoshi with less than ideal news on the patch: pic.twitter.com/syEtthtab5 August 28, 2026

Even though Valve has kept Deadlock an invite-only game since its debut, the last year of updates have gotten it to a place that feels like it could go fully public as an open beta. You never know with Valve, a studio that has spent years on projects only to quietly abandon them before. But the Old Gods, New Blood update was the first time it made a big deal of a new patch, creating an entire webpage dedicated to it and letting the community vote on the release order of the new heroes.
It was an unprecedented level of effort that seemed to suggest Deadlock had a relatively large amount of weight behind it for a Valve project. Since then, the updates have kept a steady pace.

Whether or not Yoshi's acknowledgement of the pizza thing is tongue-in-cheek, it does make it seem like the team behind Deadlock is aware that players desperately want more from the game and that it plans to deliver on that as fast as it can. I hope it also means Deadlock is closer than ever to opening the gates for everyone to try its sharply-designed mix of MOBA and hero shooter mechanics.

news.title: HoYo 的合作怪物杀手 Nodusfall 的所有关键细节
news.summary: Paimon could never.

content.v: Nodusfall may look like developer miHoYo has slapped an Elden Ring-colored paint job onto Monster Hunter, but there's some signature HoYo innovation to find in between all those beastly battles and dark fantasy landscapes in its reveal trailer.

While there aren't an awful lot of specifics about the game right now, I've scraped together every gameplay clip and interview available to help explain what HoYo's breakup with anime girls is all about. From betas, to gacha, to gameplay and story, here's everything we know about Nodusfall so far.
Nodusfall release date speculation
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZvTRQgApsSq669wkVSf6iF.jpg
Nodusfall release date details and speculation

Nodusfall doesn't have a solid release date yet—it doesn't even have a release year. That's typical for a HoYo game, though. It doesn't tend to announce release dates until a game's final round of beta testing is coming up.

Even though there's no release window HoYo's ever-reliable pattern of three open betas before release lets us predict that Nodusfall will launch sometime in 2028. Especially as its next game, Petit Planet, is out this winter, and Honkai: Nexus Anima seems set for a 2027 release, having just finished its second open beta.

The only thing that might throw a spanner in the works is that Nodusfall isn't your typical character/critter collector that HoYo is known for. So it might not be so typical when it comes to beta testing either.
Nodusfall beta and pre-registration

Speaking of betas, you can visit the official Nodusfall site and do a two-for-one combo by pre-registering and then answering a questionnaire for possible beta selection right after. The site mentions that this is for future betas, not for one ongoing right now. So you won't be fighting those Nodusfall bosses just yet no matter how furiously fast you refresh your inbox.
Nodusfall trailers

If you want a refresh on its gorgeous dark fantasy visuals and otherworldly boss designs that'd make Elden Ring and Diablo blush, here's the reveal trailer above. There's not much gameplay here, but what there is definitely throws up inevitable comparisons to co-op combat seen in the Monster Hunter series.
Nodusfall story and setting
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/myxEcLDGu2ZNVk7gNwLtmF.jpg

The story of Nodusfall unfolds across a dark fantasy "mythic continent" teeming with corrupted legendary creatures, whose designs take inspiration from both Eastern and Western mythology. Like manticores, dragons, and giant bears. You take on the role of a "Weaver," a being "enlightened by the divine" and entrusted with sacred missions to restore order to the continent corrupted by the "Dreadnodi". So basically, you're a big important badass with divine magic powers and chunky weapons whose mission is to blast scary monsters to get new gear save the world.

On your way to annihilating ethereal beasts and untold horrors, you'll journey through distinct regions with landscapes and cultures that take equal inspiration from various real-life cultures and mythologies, with more regions set to launch post-release. My fellow Genshin Impact players will be familiar with this formula.

Thanks to its reveal trailer, we know that some of Nodusfall's landscapes include golden hills, fiery skies, dreary moors, misty forests, dusty deserts, and gargantuan canyons. So far so Elden Ring, but it sounds like there's more variety in the works.

What I'm most interested in seeing is just how dark Nodusfall ends up being. The reveal trailer suggested a mature story, which isn't a first for HoYo—Genshin has dropped its fair share of dark lore and ran—but not shifting to a wisecrack or bonkers anime moment right after would be new.
Nodusfall gameplay

Breaking from the single-player teambuilding mold that HoYo is known for, Nodusfall is actually a free-to-play co-op action game that pits you and your squad against mythical creatures. Pick a character, build a loadout, and work with up to three other players to defeat difficult bosses and get the resources needed to unlock new skills and forge new weapons.
Why yes, it is eyebrow-raisingly similar to Monster Hunter, but there are some key differences. Such as:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2mpVcLf9KmbMNZYXEq8UkF.jpg

And although not expanded on, Nodusfall's official site claims that you can "switch roles and loadouts at will". Which presumably means you're not locked to playing just one character or build per account.

In practice, judging from hands-on impressions and what little gameplay there is right now, Nodusfall looks like it's actually a mix of Elden Ring, an MMO, and Monster Hunter—not just a Monster Hunter wannabe. Yeah, this may just sound like even more games that Nodusfall is riffing on, but if there's one thing I've learned about playing HoYo games over the years it's that you should never doubt its ability to innovate on the familiar and create one heck of a satisfying combat loop.
We played Nodusfall

PC Gamer's Fraser Brown played Nodusfall right after its reveal and was pretty impressed, even as a HoYo skeptic. "First of all: Nodusfall is not remotely a soulslike," Fraser says in his Nodusfall preview . "Monster Hunter is a closer relative. Solo adventurers and groups can select contracts, and then go out into the world to hunt down big beasties. These are lengthy, elaborate fights with multiple phases, taking place in spacious outdoor areas."

"I became rather fond of the clash mechanic, where you charge up a strong attack, and release it right as the monster is about to hit you, countering the attack. It helps that I looked stylish doing it, with my already massive sword growing, transforming into a magical, glowing WMD."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pWPUfoebFs7xRf6fpgUtfX.jpg
Is Nodusfall gacha?

There is no character gacha in Nodusfall , which means you'll never have to rely on luck (or piles of cash) to get new characters—they're all obtained by simply playing the story. No official line on if anything else will be linked to gacha systems, but HoYo has stated that cosmetic monetization is "an important avenue" that it'll be considering for Nodusfall.

So no, Nodusfall is not a gacha game in the traditional sense , but it may end up incorporating some RNG pulls elsewhere. Maybe for exclusive cosmetics similar to Where Winds Meet, or maybe even some special type of gear. Or maybe we'll get the biggest win of all and Nodusfall will be entirely gacha-free! (Please let me dream.)

news.title: 《漫长的黑暗》将再次获得新的 DLC，因为工作室将开发人员从续集转移到“不确定”的行业中生存：“我们必须适应这一点”
news.summary: Blackfrost's early access release won't make it this year after all.

content.v: Survival game The Long Dark was supposed to be over when its final story episode was released earlier this year . Developer Hinterland announced its sequel, Blackfrost , two years ago and planned to go the early access route with it just like the first game.

According to a new update from the studio, however, those plans have changed a little bit. While it continues to work on Blackfrost in the background, a small team of developers have been moved back onto The Long Dark to make new DLC for its survival mode. Hinterland hopes going back to the 9-year-old game will help it endure an "uncertain" industry.

"When we first announced Blackfrost, the sequel to The Long Dark, the game industry was in a very different place," it said. "In the short time since, entire business models have been thrown into chaos, the geopolitical situation has become extremely complicated, the picture of what the next generation of console hardware will be has become a lot less clear, and the amount of time and money players spend on new games has declined as everyone turns to the comfort and security of games they already know."

Over the next two years, the studio plans to continue updating the survival sandbox mode in the game with bug fixes, quality-of-life improvements, new features, and new regions from the final story episode. It's also going to release new DLC, one of which will come out piecemeal like its previous Tales From The Far Territory expansion pass. The second DLC "will be… different from that," it said, withholding info because it's still early in development.

Hinterland assured everyone Blackfrost is still in the works but said that its early access launch has been pushed to next year. The studio remains independent despite having publishers reach out to help with the sequel. "We've not yet encountered a partner who we feel is truly motivated by what's best for Hinterland or for our players, so we'll continue to self-fund and self-publish the game."

Hinterland said it's considering raising the price of the standalone Survival Mode as well as the new DLCs to help offset the loss from people buying them on sale. "We’re also mindful that the economic reality faced by a ton of folks today is that prices are increasing everywhere and you probably can’t really afford for games to get more expensive as well," it said. "We’re really trying to find a good balance here." Given the flood of layoffs across the games industry in the last few years and the cost of hardware skyrocketing , I can see why an indie studio like Hinterland would go back to what works as people are forced to be more picky than ever about what they spend money on. It's already hard enough making a splash on the crowded pages of Steam when you release a new game. I just hope it works out and it can continue to make the sort of things it wants to without feeling anchored to its breakout release.

content.v: No disc drive, no buy?
Sony’s supercharged PS5 Pro hardware model is selling out in the US as GTA 6 fever takes hold – despite an ongoing blackout protest taking place against PlayStation hardware.

Fans have mobilised to keep their consoles unplugged indefinitely , but such is the demand for the PS5’s most powerful model that third-party sellers are charging as much as $1,300 for the device on Amazon . That’s a huge mark-up on its $900 MSRP.

news.title: 被 Steam 宠坏的现代玩家永远不会理解 MegaPak 的乐趣
news.summary: A requiem for the early days of budget PC gaming.

content.v: Weird Weekend is our regular Saturday column where we celebrate PC gaming oddities: peculiar games, strange bits of trivia, forgotten history. Pop back every weekend to find out what Jeremy, Josh, Ted, and Rick have become obsessed with this time, whether it's the canon height of Thief's Garrett or that time someone in the Vatican pirated Football Manager .

It's easy to be cynical about the modern games industry, what with developers being laid off left and right and hardware prices skyrocketing thanks to AI datacentres gobbling up all the components. But it's also worth pointing out the positives too. For starters, games are more abundant than ever before. More games get released in a single day than most people could feasibly play in an entire year, and those games cover every genre and experience imaginable. If you can think of a game you want to play, it probably exists in some form. If it doesn't, someone is probably trying to make it.

As well as being omnipresent, games are cheaper than they've ever been too. This statement might seem spurious in the era of £70 games. But aside from the fact that, relative to inflation, games are technically cheaper than they were thirty years ago, it doesn't account for the endless stream of bundles and giveaways across all digital platforms. They're so frequent that, by the time you've finished playing your current game, there's a good chance you'll be able to grab what you want to play next on some form of discount.

In short, we're spoiled for choice in a way that's drastically different from how the gaming scene was thirty years ago, when games were significantly less numerous and generally less accessible financially. It's hard to estimate because everybody's experience varies. But I think, in 1996, if you were buying a new game every month, you would have been considered to be doing pretty well. For most people, new games would have been limited to Christmases and birthdays, and a lot of people would have experienced games through shareware demos or hooky copies burned onto a CD by your mate.

I don't want to turn this article into a Facebook post by your grandad, so let's stress that even if the number of game releases was far fewer, it didn't feel like that. Still, the idea of being able to hoover up a whole bunch of PC games for pennies was virtually unthinkable.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xMyxZh3evw4FgBhBtnpYrK.jpg

There was one big exception though—the MegaPak. The MegaPak was the closest thing we had to Humble Bundle (without the charity element), a big-box compilation of games that had typically been released one or two years prior. The MegPak was the production of Megamedia Corp, which has relatively little footprint online. But I can tell you that its handful of other publishing credentials include the Ukrainian Quake clone Chasm: The Rift .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ePfEGFZT576Mwxi8zVKqLV.jpg

The first Megapak was released in 1994, featuring eleven games. You can tell this because the box proudly displays the number 11 in massive yellow font, which I suppose indicates how novel the concept was. It has also led some database sites to label it as "Megapak 11", which was incredibly confusing for me when researching for this article because the Megapak line ended at number 10.

Nonetheless, it was probably right for Megapak to focus on the number of games for marketing purposes, because the quality of the titles in the pack is, shall we say, variable? The highlights of the first Megapak are Ultima spinoff World of Ultima: The Savage Empire, combat flight sim F-14 Tomcat, and Test Drive 3: The Passion—a title that makes it sound like a vehicular reimagining of Christ's crucifixion. Also included was Dinosaur Safari, an edu-tainment game that was halfway between an adventure game and Microsoft Encarta. I bring this up for no reason other than I played a ton of it on my dad's PC—Megapak notwithstanding.

This is a typical overview of the content of a Megapak, a lesser title from a big franchise, a bunch of fair to middling vehicle simulators, and a couple of oddball picks thrown in. As time went on, juicier games began to appear. Megapak 2 included Ocean's Jurassic Park, which people fondly remember today. Megapak 3, meanwhile, had TFX, a jet-fighting sim that was a cut above most combat sims of the era.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/JcxTUU98X9EbfBhW7e9T3Q.jpg

The heyday of the Megapak came in 1996, when Megapak 5 arrived. Among the pinball game and pool simulators were several genuine PC gaming heavyweights. Most notable was Jagged Alliance, the mercenary turn-based tactics games which alongside X-COM helped formalise the genre. Also included was Apogee's Descent rival Terminal Velocity , and Looking Glass' Flight Unlimited, a well-regarded flight sim which has been somewhat forgotten in the wake of games like Thief and System Shock 2 .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/i4QMiiM8z7XDS7JT9t7D6.jpg

These weren't the best games that would eventually feature on a Megapak. Megapak 7 has Caesar 2 and Heroes of Might and Magic, while Megapak 8 treated players to SimCity 2000 and Mechwarrior II. But Megapak 5 was the best expression of what a Megapak was meant to be, a snapshot of PC gaming in the present moment.

Megapak 5 was also the first of them I personally owned, gifted as a Christmas present in 1997. The main thing I remember about it, outside of the games themselves, is the weight of the box. Each game came on its own CD in a paper sleeve, and if I remember rightly, the pack had a bespoke manual thick enough to kill a large insect or small rodent. You could feel the value of it in your hands.

The grab-bag nature of it was also part of the appeal. I was too young to have much foreknowledge of which games in the box were worth my time and which weren't, so there was an element of discovery in playing them. It was through Megapak 5 that I discovered Entomorph: Plague of the Darkfall , which was my introduction to roleplaying games and has been lodged in my head ever since.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/S4rMxADikLATLb4MMvHLGU.jpg

The Megapak era burned bright and faded quickly, with nine volumes released between 1994 and 1998. What happened to Megapak Corp afterwards isn't entirely clear. A tenth and final Megapak collection appeared in 2001. But it was published by Empire Interactive rather than Megamedia Corp. All the games featured on this Megapak were also Empire-published titles.

Clearly then, the Megapak license transitioned from Megamedia Corp to Empire in some fashion. Unfortunately, I couldn't find any information online to confirm this, and there seems to be no mention of the Megapak name or Megamedia Corp in Empire's published accounts.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hUpbi3g6GL9d7xBU8fNvag.jpg

Either way, there is a clear indication of why the Megapak line came to an end. In 2000, Empire launched Xplosiv, its own range of budget titles, which, alongside Sold Out, became one of the two main brands you'd find piling up in the bargain bin of UK game stores nationwide. Hence the likely scenarios are that Empire bought Megapak to kill the competition, opted not to continue with the series after a poor performance from Megapak 10, or entered into a publishing agreement with Megamedia Corp for Megapak 10 while spinning up its own budget range on the sly.

Whatever happened, the upshot was that the era of big-box PC compilations ended, and the era of lurid orange DVD cases began. I don't begrudge that—I had plenty of fun with those later budget lines too. Nor would I choose to go back to the Megapak era over our modern age of abundant, easily accessible games.

news.title: Fibbage纸牌游戏评论

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/fibbage-thumb-1787947104062.jpg
如果您在 2010 年代中期参加聚会，那么您很有可能至少在其中一些聚会中参加了由 Jackbox Games 背后的人员开发的聚会游戏“Fibbage”。自 2014 年第一款游戏发布以来，这款数字派对游戏在过去的 12 年里经历了多次迭代，现在 Jackbox Games 正在切断线缆，将这款主流派对游戏带到桌面上，推出适合您的棋盘游戏之夜的卡牌版本。

有助于制作这款数字虚张声势游戏的所有规则都已延续到这款新纸牌游戏中。与其他迭代一样，在《Fibbage》中，其中一名玩家将充当“揭秘者”，他将抽一张牌并大声朗读提示，其中一部分被空白，然后由其他玩家写下一个合理的选项来完成提示。然而，提出提示的人将会得到正确答案，并将其写下来并添加为正确答案。玩家们都会输入他们的答案，这些答案将被打乱，然后是一个投票期，你可以投票选出你认为正确的答案。从那里开始，根据您是否猜对以及其他人是否投票支持您的提交来获得积分，并且在您决定的无论多少轮（默认情况下为六轮）结束时得分最高的人获胜。
盒子的大小与标准精装书差不多，里面有单面纸（另一面是 Jackbox Party Pack 4 的广告）、纸板投票/积分代币（但奇怪的是没有袋子可以放进去）、六块带木板的干擦记号笔和 300 张带有提示的卡片。这些提示本身涵盖了一系列不拘一格的主题，从询问用吹风机烹饪鸭子的厨师到百事可乐的日本独有口味。令人印象深刻的卡牌数量意味着您将需要完成大量游戏才能开始多次重复，这很棒。
Fibbage Card Game，就像数字版本一样，已经成熟了，可以一次又一次地扩展，并且了解 Jackbox，我想用不了多久我们就会开始看到额外的提示卡包、不同主题的提示以及额外的标记和书写板。只要你有东西可以写，有东西可以记录分数，你就没有任何理由不能将玩家数量扩展到你想要的数量。
《Fibbage》的一切都相当成功地跳转到了实体游戏，只有一个小小的例外——写答案部分。有效吗？当然。问题是，考虑到揭露者知道答案，除非你们的小组有非常相似的笔迹，或者至少写了相似的方框字母（游戏建议你使用），否则不久你可能会开始识别玩家的笔迹。尤其是在玩家人数较少的游戏中。我遇到的一个情况。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/fibbage-2-1787946651985.jpg
我想出的一个自制魔法是，我让揭露者收集提交的内容，然后在另一张纸上抄下所有答案，然后小组对该列表进行投票。它确实增加了一个额外的步骤和更多的时间，但这确实设法使选票与答案挂钩，而不是每个人都假装自己是法医文件审查员（我查了一下；FDE 查看并比较法院的笔迹和签名 - 也可能是也可能不是其中一张卡片上的问题）。
不管你怎么玩，《Fibbage》都是我最喜欢的纯派对游戏之一。这是一款即使是老奶奶和爷爷也能玩得开心的游戏。我一直很欣赏《Fibbage》对玩家的要求更高，要求你更加聪明和有创造力，而不是过分依赖“谁的反应最有趣”来得分。我发现《反人类纸牌》和其他游戏往往会陷入这种结果。 Fibbage 的物理版本是对一款游戏的忠实改编，该游戏在派对上广受好评，我可以看到自己经常推出这款游戏。

news.title: 我希望 MMO 再次浪费我们的时间
news.summary: I've accomplished very little on a Star Wars Galaxies private server, and I wouldn't want it any other way.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PgGhmt5pTtxusaQQX3dHPF.png

This is Terminally Online : PC Gamer's very own MMO column. Every other week, I'll be sharing my thoughts on the genre, interviewing fellow MMO-heads like me, taking a deep-dive into mechanics we've all taken for granted, and, occasionally, bringing in guest writers to talk about their MMO of choice. Like our own Lincoln Carpenter, who's been enjoying a version of the galaxy far, far away from a long time ago.

After completing the initial tutorial on a private server for Star Wars Galaxies—the Star Wars-themed MMO that launched in 2003, was updated until 2005, and was shuttered in 2011—I was dumped out of a shuttle in Mos Eisley and into a warzone. Squads of rebel and imperial players were exchanging blaster fire and lobbing thermal detonators. When I asked the passing combatants why Tatooine was worth fighting over, a man in stormtrooper armor said I was lucky I wasn't PvP-flagged.

Despite the early-2000s assets and stiff animations, it was the most dynamic that an MMO had felt for me in years. But in the week I've spent revisiting Star Wars Galaxies, I've seen very little other excitement. I've killed no impressive enemies. I've done barely any quests. It's an MMO that's content to let me log in and do little of note whatsoever—and that's exactly what I've been missing.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/VdqTxaQMvu4KtxULVHxuD.png

In comparison, whenever the WoW itch gets strong enough for me to reup my subscription, I end up doing nothing but doing. Logging into WoW in 2026 means enduring a bombardment of refreshed weekly prompts and directives urging me to get on my flying mount and accelerate at breakneck speed towards whatever prescribed activity with prerequisite player count will provide my next predictable gear score increase.
A more civilized age

WoW has become a relentlessly efficient machine, ensuring players waste the least possible time while being propelled through seasonal ranks and escalating difficulty tiers. In terms of providing their users with those quantifiable successes, it's hard to argue that the MMOs of today aren't better designed than their older iterations. And yet, it's the moments when I step off the treadmill where they still feel the most magical.

When I can still find joy in WoW, it's not through the weekly content blitz. It's when I take the scenic route through an old leveling zone, and wonder what quest that dwarf running in the distance is doing. It's when I earn a grateful emote from a player of the opposite faction who can't otherwise thank me for helping them with a dicey fight. It's during the pinnacle of incidental MMO encounters: Receiving a sorely needed heal from a passing player who could've just as easily left me to die.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/STVfCeSkS5by4a2qdJsvX7.png

It's in those moments where it feels like the MMO rediscovers itself—where it recaptures the ways that multiplayer in a shared, persistent world can be a source of wonder, and not just a rote feature of the form. It's that wonder that motivated Star Wars Galaxies in 2003, and it's what its private server maintainers have worked to keep in suspended animation ever since.
Outer Rim living

My hours in Galaxies have been aimless ones. I've been casually puttering across the Tatooine wastelands, learning how to survey for minerals and water, how to harvest womp rat corpses for bones and how to use them to flavor what must be the world's worst tea—slowly gaining an understanding of its skill systems and crafting mechanics, but having no real idea whether I'm accomplishing anything another player would consider worthwhile.

I haven't used my blaster on anything more threatening than a nameless smuggler, and I'm not sure where I'd get a better shooting iron even if I wanted one. I could be answering the call to adventure as one of the galaxy's heroes, but the game's been content to let me ignore it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dX5Lv79Nrn6u4f9ZeDFE9C.png

And I've been content to go on ignoring. Because all that time I'm wasting out in the sands is time I've spent watching a bounty hunter tear by on a speeder bike and wondering what grim business he's on, or exchanging greetings with a Zabrak who's working on his carbine marksmanship. The hour I spent surveying eahiate iron deposits was one that led me through a sprawling, player-made city out in the dunes, its vacant tents and droid stalls and derelict cruisers parked in hand-built plazas proof that other players once shared that same space.

When I drift back through Mos Eisley, its scant environmental details and featureless wall textures feel vibrant, because the aliens, smugglers, and imperial agents I'll bump elbows with want nothing more than the pleasure of lingering there together.
Star Wars Galaxies has been dead for years—but it's a dead game that still remembers how to feel like a living world better than the market-leading MMOs that survived it.

news.title: 我们玩过《腐烂国度 3》，尽管 Xbox 发生了巨大的变化，但它的状态良好2026 年科隆游戏展
news.summary: State of Decay 3 seems to be showing promise after playing an action-packed 30 minutes of an early alpha build

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/29/vlcsnap-2026-08-29-08h23m26s892-1788017311724.png

It's been a tumultuous time for development teams around the Xbox umbrella, including Undead Labs which is in the process of changing ownership amid the "Xbox reset." This left us with tons of questions about the state of its upcoming zombie-survival game State of Decay 3 and if it'd even see the light of day. Well, I played it at gamescom 2026 and I'm happy to report that the short 30-minute demo I saw and went hands-on with shows a lot of promise. Even as an early alpha build, I got a good impression of the improved gunplay and movement, and the general feeling that this is a State of the Decay worthy of the current generation while building on the series' fundamentals.

This is still very much about community management and base-building, both of which have been expanded in a few notable ways. From what I saw, facilities and buildings don't necessarily have linear upgrade paths and can instead specialize in specific functions through branching upgrades. What's just as important is which characters you assign to which facilities – for example, those who have perks or traits suited for the medical field can boost the rate at which other survivors will recover.

What I saw in greater detail was the deeper trait system where every procedurally assembled character has their own set of perks and quirks that can evolve. These kinds of systems were a core part of State of Decay 2, and they seem to have a greater impact now. One survivor had the trait of "takes long showers," thus taking up more water resources to maintain the settlement. But he was also adept at melee combat, so perhaps his showering habits are worth the trade-off for when you want to use him in the field. Another character had a trait that said she had sniper training, offering extra damage with long-range guns and for headshots, but she was more injury prone – and with a more granular injury system that calculates damage to specific body parts and applies debuffs to certain functions (like weapon accuracy or movement speed as examples), it's something you have to take into consideration more than previous games.

When you're managing 30-plus characters, accounting for these traits can make for a really interesting dynamic when deciding who to control when fighting zombies in the field and who you assign back at base. My hope is that they'll be as impactful in the long-run as they were in the immediate hands-on I got.

But State of Decay has always been just as much about fending off hordes of zombies, and things work differently in State of Decay 3. There are plenty of towns, facilities, and general points of interest that make up its large open world and when you pull up the map, you'll see infestation networks spreading all across the world and branching into adjacent towns. Infested settlements and plague nests are the hotspots you want to hit in order to cut off the spread, and these make for intense battles.

There is always a heart of the infestation at these locations, sometimes buried beneath a facility or in the garage of an autoshop, and some could be more intricate dungeon-style areas. But it seems regardless of location, you need to find four of its weak points spread across the location in order to destroy it. You're also fending off a bunch of zombies in the process, and once you've opened the heart of the infestation, an even bigger zombie horde will come after you. It's absolute chaos when you're pumping all of your remaining bullets into the heart as bloaters and juggernauts back up the zombie wave, but once it's destroyed, the remaining zombies die out.

It sounds simple enough, but for me, the smoother and punchier gunplay helps the moment-to-moment combat feel a lot better than previous entries. It was evident with the AK-47 with a drum mag that I used to slay zombie crowds and the silenced pistol for one-tap headshots, and that was scratching the surface – I also saw how you can lure and bait groups into flammable oil spills, or use stealth more effectively to shave off a few zombies before all hell breaks loose. There's a running slide you can do to knock weaker zombies down and execute a finisher to keep the standard melee bat-swining more interesting. And as mentioned earlier, these playstyles can be further emphasized when controlling survivors with skills and traits suited for them. Overall, State of Decay 3 plays like a proper third-person shooter, and it's a great contrast to the management sim we come to the series for.

At least from this early version, it seems that the main thrust of State of Decay 3 is map-wide territory control by way of clearing out infestation sites and keeping them from coming back. Over time, infestations will spring back up and sieges on established settlements will also pose a persistent threat, which is the juggling act of survival games and something the series is familiar with. So, in the process of gathering food, water, and other utilities to keep your survivors going, there's that simulation running in the background to keep you on your toes.

Of course, there's drop-in / drop-out co-op multiplayer in State of Decay 3 and without limitations on how players within the session explore the open world. The team at Undead Labs also referenced a sort of dynamic difficulty system that makes sure that you're not blasting through zombies with total ease; it may lay off the gas pedal if you're repeatedly running into a wall as well. These are all things that are sure to be worked out as development continues, as well as the somewhat rough technical performance of the early alpha build I played.

More broadly, I hope that this dynamic of territory control via combat and settlement management sim can hold my interest when it comes time to put hours and hours into it as I did with State of Decay 2. It took time for Undead Labs to get its previous game in a good spot and is now a pretty robust package, and perhaps this upcoming entry can come out of the gate stronger.

The team is sticking to having a closed playtest toward the end of 2026 with a full release sometime in 2027 for Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam. We have plenty of hands-on previews from gamescom 2026, so be sure to check out our first impressions of Fable's combat , Gears of War: E-Day's campaign , and Metro 2039 .

Michael Higham is an editor at IGN who regularly contributes with reviews, previews, features, and news in written and video form. He's usually entrusted with covering long RPGs and tech products, but he's got range when it comes to games. You'll also catch him at events and hosting video content, including IGN's weekly podcast Unlocked .

news.title: 米哈游跳出舒适圈 新作放弃二次元变黑暗奇幻
news.summary: 外媒PushSquare今日发表文章，对米哈游在科隆游戏展上公布的全新作品《源初之结》（Nodusfall）进行了评价。

content.v: 外媒PushSquare今日发表文章，对米哈游在科隆游戏展上公布的全新作品《源初之结》（Nodusfall）进行了评价。
文章指出这款新作与米哈游以往的风格截然不同，从他们所擅长的二次元美少女风格，变为黑暗写实风格。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261416031716.png
PushSquare在报道中写道，米哈游此次公布的作品是一款基于虚幻引擎5打造的“写实奇幻动作”游戏。
官方在新闻稿中称，本作灵感来源于“多元神话”，并将强调 “多人合作玩法”。
根据官方介绍，玩家将踏入一个“神权崩塌、秩序瓦解”的世界，扮演一名“织者” （Weaver），与强大的伙伴结盟，共同对抗撼天动地的敌人，夺取残存的神性，最终恢复世界的秩序。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261416107217.png
PushSquare指出，目前业内存在争议——这款新作究竟是延续米哈游此前的免费氪金模式，还是一款买断制付费游戏，目前官方尚未明确。平台方面，虽然尚未确认是否登陆PS5，但外媒“强烈怀疑”本作将登陆PlayStation平台。
PushSquare的编辑在文章最后写道：“从我个人口味来看，这款游戏并没有像《崩坏：星穹铁道》那样立刻吸引我，但我绝对对这个工作室的这次尝试感到好奇。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261416204493.jpg

news.title: 《巫师3》资料片会卖爆！预估销量1140万份
news.summary: 根据市场分析机构的最新预测，《巫师3：狂猎》即将推出的全新资料片“旧时曲”（Songs of the Past）全球销量预计将达到1140万份。…

content.v: 根据市场分析机构的最新预测，《巫师3：狂猎》即将推出的全新资料片“旧时曲”（Songs of the Past）全球销量预计将达到1140万份。这一数字将远超常规DLC的销售体量，为开发商CD Projekt Red带来可观的利润回报。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608272317179341.jpg
“旧时曲”是《巫师3》在发售十余年后推出的第三部大型剧情扩展。其高预期销量主要得益于多重因素的叠加：
《巫师3 重制版》将于9月29日发售，大量新老玩家将在体验重制版后自然过渡到新资料片；
《巫师3》全平台累计销量已突破5000万份，即便仅有一小部分玩家购买，也能形成巨大销量；
资料片以杰洛特与丹德里恩的“兄弟情”为主线，首次探索丹德里恩家族领地“莱顿”，对系列粉丝极具吸引力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608272317231451.jpg
1140万份的DLC销量在游戏行业极为罕见。通常，大型资料片的销量约为本体销量的20%-30%，而“旧时曲”若达到这一预测值，将意味着超过五分之一的《巫师3》玩家选择购入该扩展内容，展现出IP的持续生命力。
对于CD Projekt Red而言，这不仅是短期收入的保障，也为《巫师4》的研发提供了更充裕的资金支持。
考虑到“旧时曲”将于2027年发售，届时《巫师3 重制版》的口碑与热度已充分发酵，这一销量预期并非空想。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608272317306213.jpg

news.title: 漫步在游戏世界
news.summary: ■ 1. 在科隆游戏展期间，在科隆这座城市里，你当然不只是会在屏幕里看到游戏角色。从距离场馆很远的地方开始，你就能感觉到一点儿虚拟和现实融合的滋味——一般来说，你会在路上看到盛装的Coser用各种方式向场馆移动，科隆人可

content.v: 在科隆游戏展期间，在科隆这座城市里，你当然不只是会在屏幕里看到游戏角色。从距离场馆很远的地方开始，你就能感觉到一点儿虚拟和现实融合的滋味——一般来说，你会在路上看到盛装的Coser用各种方式向场馆移动，科隆人可能也是见多识广，对此保持着见怪不怪的态度，你和一个士官长、一个地狱潜兵和一个不知道什么游戏里的精灵同行，走向场馆，这种感觉非常奇妙。离场馆越近，现实中的游戏元素就越多，进了场馆——这里的Coser密度达到了你随便向任何一个方向看上去都至少能找到三五个Coser的程度。除此之外。各大公司的展台上有各式各样的角色雕像，很多展台本身就是一个巨型奇观。
大家来游戏展不就是为了这些吗！我们在声光电效果的包围中排上几个小时的队，为了玩到15分钟某个还没发售的游戏或者和某个游戏角色合个影什么的，在这些天的科隆，现实和虚拟世界一定程度的融合了。

不过距离拥挤的科隆游戏展主展馆大概30分钟车程之外，还有一个没有这么拥挤热闹但同样很有趣的展览，“Worlds of Play: The Game Art Exhibition”。这是一个由腾讯游戏联合全球多家工作室发起的游戏艺术展览，里面陈列着一些由游戏衍生的艺术展品，有相对常见的雕像、手办，也有并不常见，甚至首次向公众开放的设计图、概念作品、衍生艺术品甚至装置艺术。腾讯在会场附近提供了接驳车，任何玩家都可以免费参观这场游戏展览。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-29/1256a92e3b053302.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
我是在27号下午临近当日展览结束的时候去这个展览的，大概是5点左右吧，去得有点儿晚，到了场馆的时候那里已经接近闭馆了，展览主办方的人看起来以腾讯游戏的员工为主，可能是在科隆游戏展期间千里迢迢跑过来负责这个展览的布展和接待工作，他们穿着“Worlds of Play”的黑色T恤，看起来刚经历过高强度的布展工作和接待工作，有些人甚至显得有一些恍惚。
这个地方看起来曾经是个工业园区，建筑大多低矮宽大，我还在门口看到了一台已经废弃的塔式起重机，工业风情油然而生。展览馆本身倒是非常优雅，一副德国现代建筑的样子。这个时间段有一个好处，就是可以相对安静地参观整个展览。
或许因为所有这些的影响，Worlds of Play给我的整体感觉是沉静而温和的。和十公里外那种让人全方位置于感官冲击的科隆游戏展展馆不同，这个游戏艺术展就像所有真正的艺术展那样平静。展品本身的展示方式完全不喧哗，他们就非常自然和安静地以恰当的形式展示着。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-29/6276a92e3d5ea2d1.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

我看过不少博物馆和展览，因此也有些看展心得。展览这个东西看起来平平无奇，但其实对环境和投入要求非常高。如何恰当地把观众的注意力引导到展品上，不会被周边环境干扰，但又让人觉得舒服其实是个技术活儿——许多经验和成本投入进去，就是为了让很多东西不引人注意的。具体到这个Worlds of Play展览，虽然规模不算大，看起来也是一个临时搭建的展览，但搞得相当有模有样。有一些展室的整体氛围很有意思，很多展品的展示和灯光也很考究。整个展览的动线应该是受到建筑条件所限，坦率来说并不足够好，但也明显看出经过了用心的设计，算是在有限的条件下达到了相对很好的效果。总体来说，在这个展览中，我能感觉到游戏是被认真而严肃地对待的。
根据介绍，这个展览收录了来自20多家工作室的40余款游戏作品，包括《刺客信条》《艾尔登法环》《控制》《英雄联盟》等在全球游戏史和流行文化中已经建立起稳固位置的名字，也包括《黑神话：悟空》《影之刃零》《三角洲行动》《王者荣耀》《鸣潮》《光与夜之恋》等中国玩家更熟悉的作品。展品包括概念原画、创作手稿、角色雕塑、比例模型、影像和互动装置。

大部分展品都很有意思，有些展品我确实见过——比如《黑神话：悟空》的一些人物雕像，或者《王者荣耀》相关的雕塑、设计图稿什么的——把这些东西运到科隆，布置起来，怎么想都是一个费心费力的活儿。还有大量展品我是第一次见。整个展览里给我留下深刻印象的地方有不少，比如《影之刃零》的展示——他们在展览中搭了一个亭子，里面布满了红线，红线是《影之刃零》的标志性元素，这个展厅也因此气氛十足。再比如《博德之门 3》的巨型鹦鹉螺，《三角洲行动》搞了一个黑鹰直升机的布景，《暗区突围》展示了三套国风战术甲胄，也非常有感觉。从艺术角度讲，让我印象深刻的展区是《原子之心》的，除了一些陈设品之外，背景挂着一张大幅面绘画作品，尺寸大概至少有3米X5米，一整面墙，有非常明显的俄罗斯构成主义和苏联先锋派风格，哪怕在这种艺术场合里都格外显得艺术。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-29/7616a92e41430e61.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

另外一个比较有意思的地方是二层的RIOT展厅，这个展厅整体被布置成一个沉浸式数字影像装置，布展人利用环绕投影、半透明LED幕和动态灯光，给观众提供一种沉浸式的体验。这个想法非常奇妙而聪明，它提供了一种“气氛”，虽然没有具体的展品，但整个展厅给人的感觉和RIOT和它的产品给人的感觉是非常契合的。展厅里还有一些互动装置，比如用感应式的手柄在屏幕上画画，然后你画的图案被放到大屏幕上展示的——看起来是个数字留言板，还有一个拍照，然后用AI后期处理，最后把照片P成游戏角色的设备，工作人员盛情邀请之下，我试了试，留下一些效果一言难尽的照片——可能比较符合美国人概念中的“潮”，但我确实不太适应。
展览的规模其实并不大，大体走马观花地观看，差不多45分钟就能走完全程。如果展览里有你自己喜欢的游戏，认真地看的话，1个半小时也差不多完事儿了。

身为游戏行业的从业者，我感触最深的倒不是这些展品本身，而是这个展览的气氛。具体来说可能有几个，首先，我能感觉到这个展览是非常严肃的，一个有趣的点在于，它没有把所有的展品完全作为“游戏产品”的附庸。在很多游戏展览中，游戏的LOGO总是被放在最醒目的位置，因为我们心照不宣地认为展品本身是依附于“对应的游戏产品”而存在的，这当然有现实意义，但也弱化了展品本身。在这个展览中，展品本身的艺术价值被最大程度地强调了。平心而论，这个展览里涉及到的游戏有一些是我平时不太接触，不太擅长甚至不那么了解的游戏类型——但哪怕一个参观者不了解这些展品对应的游戏，甚至不了解游戏，这里很多展品和展区仍然是合格的“展览”。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-29/9506a92e43f33cdc.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
另一点是这个展览的组织形式，它没有把游戏按开发商、游戏玩法或者别的什么分类划分区域，在这个展览里，所有展品没有什么不同，没有什么更重要或者不重要，所有的展品在这个展览中的地位都是相对平等的，这些展品甚至和它们本身的游戏规模和影响力都不完全相关，它们就只是从“展览”的角度被组织和排列，以一个相对整体的概念出现在我的面前。这些设计都让我很有好感。

但最让我喜欢的还是这个展览的理直气壮的劲儿——我看过很多不少有游戏元素，或者收录游戏作品的展览。其实传统博物馆干这事儿也有很多年了（有趣的是，传统博物馆反而会倾向于用游戏机和屏幕来展示游戏）。把游戏衍生的艺术作品放进博物馆相对来说并不多见，但也并不是没有。但是，大多数类似的展览总会大张旗鼓地做很多前置解释，比如游戏是一种新兴媒介啦，游戏促进了科技的发展啦，游戏有益于玩家身心或者快速在青少年中风靡啦，诸如此类。
最初看一两次，你还会有一点“游戏终于被主流价值承认了”的信息，但看得越多，就越觉得隐隐不对劲，在很多时候，在这些传统价值观充斥的展馆里，游戏本身是作为一种“打破规则的奇观”出现的。人们总是更重视游戏代表的趋势，反而忽视了游戏本身，或者说忽视了游戏开发者本身在其中的艺术追求和表达。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-29/4486a92e479bbc45.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
我觉得这当然是不公平的，游戏行业已经解释了太多次啦，因此，我看到这个展览——我喜欢它的平静和自信的劲儿——我们不会争辩游戏是不是艺术这种过时的话题。游戏就是艺术，而且不仅游戏产品本身是艺术，在它的诞生过程中也凝聚着无数艺术家的灵感和表达，因而艺术行为存在于游戏的整个生命周期中，一个游戏的创意萌发、制作开发、发布，以及长期运营是一条完整的不可分割的链条，艺术闪耀在这条链条中的任何一个环节上。
这个展览就是用这种坦率的态度对待游戏和游戏过程中的艺术的。在这种态度面前，这个展览本身的不成熟之处根本不重要——现在不成熟又怎么样？有一些缺憾又有什么关系，它总会成熟起来，解决掉这些问题的。
这次展览的所有游戏产品都是腾讯旗下，或和腾讯有投资关系的团队。这也很正常，腾讯投入人力物力，把这些作品运到科隆，办一个艺术展，当然也希望它能够产生品牌影响力，一定程度地展示腾讯在全球游戏产业中的关系和影响力，这非常合理。世界上大多数有企业参与的文化活动背后都有类似的考虑。
在某种意义上我觉得这个展览仍然一定程度领先于当前时代，也就是说，我完全相信，哪怕是在现在的科隆，哪怕有大量的游戏玩家和游戏从业者来看这个展览，也未必会意识到这个展览所代表的意义。从展览本体来说，就我之前而言，硬件条件和规模都有所限制，从这个展览本身传达的东西而言，它仍然显得有点超前——但也就像我所说的那样，随着时间推移，随着这样的展览接力办下去，一切都会慢慢好起来的。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-29/6666a92e4a6efe70.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

所以我对这个展览有另一个颇有好感的地方，就是它没有搞一个“中国游戏专区”。这个展览里当然有国内开发者制作的游戏，也有国外开发者制作的游戏，有在全世界范围内很出名的游戏，也有在全世界范围内不那么出名的游戏。但所有展品都非常自然地陈列在一起，换言之，国产游戏不需要先证明“中国游戏现在也可以表达了”，才有资格和《艾尔登法环》或者《博德之门 3》并列。甚至于，中国游戏并不需要强调“专属于中国的表达”，表达就是表达，虽然因为创作者本身的生长环境和经历自然而然地会有区别，但所有的表达之间是不分大小高低的。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-29/3896a92e4dbea940.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
坦率地说，我认为中国游戏行业目前的成绩没有得到足够的承认，当中国游戏开发者，或者中国商业游戏开发者已经开始表达，熟悉表达，甚至完全自然而然地表达了之后，却没有得到外界的足够肯定和认可。
这里面的确有历史遗留问题，我们在此之前的确不擅长表达，或者说，从主观和客观上，在此之前，都有很多原因让我们把“表达”这件事的优先级不停地往后调。但另一方面，仍然是从主观和客观上，在现在，我们也造就开始而且重视表达本身了。

但外界，或者说，中国之外的对这种改变的认知仍然是滞后的，或者说，“中国游戏开发者忽视表达”这种观点已经形成了一种固化印象，在这种固化印象之下，许多表达被有意或无意地忽视了。我当然喜欢《原子之心》的美学表达，但《影之刃零》难道不是也有自己的美学表达吗？我们当然喜欢《博德之门3》或者《层层恐惧》的世界观，但难道我们的开发者不是抱着同样的热情和专业程度制作《三角洲行动》和《暗区突围》的吗？这仍然同样是表达。我们的开发者在开发《光与夜之恋》或者《鸣潮》的时候，也当然有一些专门属于我们、适合我们，甚至不一定普适于整个世界的情感表达，那又怎么样呢？这些表达难道不是和那些强势文化的表达一样，具备同样的价值吗？

不过让我们心平气和地看待这件事，挑战固有秩序的新兴势力总是会遭遇这些的。我并不是一个民族主义者，事实上我更接近一个朴素的世界主义者。我相信所有民族和所有人都应该是平等的，但在最近几年，仅就游戏行业而言，我确实也觉得中国游戏行业对全球游戏行业的贡献与它得到的评价并不完全匹配——但这篇文章里我不准备展开过多，或者说，让我们先试试解决问题——腾讯其实很擅长做这种事情，放下概念上的争议，试试做点实际的事情，从长期着手，看看有没有可能让事情变好哪怕一点点。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-29/4196a92e50cc9f61.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

这个展览一定程度上可能就是为了解决这个问题，改变偏见，让我们能够得到相对平等的对待，得到应得的承认和认可。当然，这个问题不会那么好解决，不会那么快解决，甚至可能在很长一段时间里显得毫无进展甚至有些滑稽——但很多事情就是这样的，很多时候你可能会努力很长时间但看不到任何结果，就好像在泥泞中转圈，但忽然有那么一个时刻，仿佛真的是忽然之间，你发现终点就在你面前，这个时候你会感觉到其实之前的努力和坚持都是有必要的。

所以让我们把这个刚诞生的展览看成是旅程上的某一步吧，又或者我们不去想那些太宏大的事情，就享受这个展览本身。它是一个很诚恳的游戏展览，我希望这样的展览会一直持续下去，可能是周期性的，又或者会变成常设的。它或许在未来会每年随科隆游戏展开设，甚至有可能办成一个流动性的常规展览，在世界各个城市巡回展出。它或许承载着某些重要的意义，但去参展的人可以不用去想这些，这样的展览越多越好，观众只需要在1个小时里沉浸在游戏和艺术的世界中就很好了，显而易见，这个叫“Worlds of Play”的展览做到了这一点。

news.title: 邹市明给冉莹颖惊喜惹怒岳母 妈妈吐槽早晚要被气死
news.summary: 在姐姐当家节目中，冉莹颖回老家和家人团聚，邹市明本想给妻子冉莹颖一个“惊喜”安排她与多年未见的生父相见以解心结

content.v: 8月29日，在姐姐当家节目中，冉莹颖回老家和家人团聚，邹市明本想给妻子冉莹颖一个“惊喜”安排她与多年未见的生父相见以解心结，却因未提前商量惹怒岳母。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_23/176.jpg
邹市明心疼妻子冉莹颖自幼缺失父爱，想私下联系并约见她多年未见的生父，把话说开、解开她的心结。他没和妻子、岳母商量，就擅自联系了岳父，并约定了次日上午见面，试图促成父女和解。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_23/1165.jpg
岳母得知女婿私下联系了曾缺席家庭且有过家暴行为的前夫后，当场情绪爆发，愤怒吐槽“早晚要被邹市明气死”，指责他做事情不跟自己商量。冉莹颖幼时父母离异，父亲重男轻女且家暴，母亲一人打三份工将她养大。邹市明的安排，触痛了岳母半生未愈的伤疤。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_23/1286.jpg
事后邹市明发文道歉，承认自己行事莽撞，在深刻反思，并称“爱就是不断学习和进步的过程”。冉莹颖被夹在中间两难，她并未做好和解准备，贸然相见可能让她觉得辜负了母亲多年的辛苦。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_23/1375.jpg

news.title: “火星哥”说朴彩英不接他电话 想在韩国表演《APT》
news.summary: 火星哥布鲁诺·马尔斯（Bruno Mars）近日在关于首尔演唱会的采访中公开隔空喊话朴彩英（ROSÉ）

content.v: 火星哥布鲁诺·马尔斯（Bruno Mars）近日在关于首尔演唱会的采访中公开隔空喊话朴彩英（ROSÉ），希望她能来韩国同台表演爆款合作曲《APT.》，还幽默吐槽她“身价太高”“连电话都不接了”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_22/199.jpg
火星哥在采访中直接向朴彩英喊话：“Rosie，如果你在听、如果你在看，我要怎么做才能和你一起在韩国表演《APT.》？” 他称如果促成同台，将是“一个真正圆满的时刻”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_22/1187.jpg
此前，网络上有传言称火星哥不接朴彩英的电话，将合作中断归咎于女方。 而火星哥此次亲口说出“她现在连我的电话都不接了”，被认为是亲自下场澄清，完成了一次“回旋镖”式的反转。
此前，火星哥就曾幽默感谢朴彩英，因为《APT.》的成功帮他“还清了债务”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_22/1315.jpg

news.title: 免费更新将放缓 《红色沙漠》全力推进年内DLC开发
news.summary: 《红色沙漠》免费更新节奏将放缓，Pearl Abyss将开发资源转向年内推出的DLC。

content.v: 在2026科隆游戏展开幕之夜上，Pearl Abyss公开了《红色沙漠》的“Enhanced”增强版，包含全新的2.0更新，为游戏补充了更多剧情内容、新增故事段落与多语言选项。这次更新也可视为官方对游戏发售后一系列优化的收束。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270936081174.png
据Pearl Abyss公关与市场营销总监Will Powers接受IGN采访时介绍，此前的免费更新一直保持较高节奏，持续扩展帕卫尔大陆的内容。而随着2.0版本推出，这一节奏将出现变化：“此后更新仍会推出，但在规模、体量与频率上不会再像此前那样稳定。”工作室将把开发资源从常规更新转向即将到来的DLC。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270939134612.jpg
Powers表示，这是一个“很好的过渡节点”，2.0代表帕卫尔大陆一个内容完整体验的落地。目前《红色沙漠》DLC仍计划在年内推出，具体内容与后续扩展规划尚未公开。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608270939239044.jpg
《红色沙漠》自2026年3月发售后取得不俗成绩，发售不到4周全球销量突破500万份，Steam日活跃峰值维持在约10万。Pearl Abyss此前也表示，在主线大获成功后，对这款新兴IP还有包括续作、多人模式以及更多DLC在内的扩展计划。

news.title: 昭和米国物语全新难度：昭和男儿|平成废宅 还有高手
news.summary: 《昭和米国物语》创意总监、制作人NEKCON猫老大亲自回应游戏难度。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292235079513.png
近日，有玩家在科隆游戏展现场试玩《昭和米国物语》，发现游戏的难度选项颇具特色，分别被命名为“平成肥宅”和“昭和男儿”，对应简单与困难难度。
这一设定也引起了动漫博主里神楽的注意，其在社交平台发问：“有没有令和难度？”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292237077180.png
对此，《昭和米国物语》创意总监、制作人NEKCON猫老大亲自回应称，“有啊”， 并透露游戏实际上准备了三种难度 ，本次科隆现场试玩只开放了普通和困难两档。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292232156552.png
至于第三种“令和难度”，NEKCON猫老大笑称：“令和巨婴的自动连段过于无脑了，我个人比较喜欢，年纪大了。”
他同时解释，《昭和米国物语》本质上是一款重视技能树成长和数值养成的RPG，因此并不会刻意通过提高难度来为难玩家。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292237232975.png
也就是说，虽然游戏的难度名称充满了玩梗元素，但开发团队并没有打算让玩家单纯靠受苦来获得挑战感，而是希望通过技能树、角色成长和数值养成来构成RPG体验。

news.title: 《天国拯救2》总监批《GTA6》 称其毫无故事线可言
news.summary: 《天国：拯救2》总监批《GTA6》无故事钩子，称技术虽惊艳、主角却无趣，R星尚未回应。

content.v: 8月28日，《天国：拯救2》总监丹尼尔·瓦夫拉（Daniel Vávra）在社交平台发文，直言R星的《GTA6》“毫无毫无故事线可言”。在《GTA6》收获游戏圈几乎一边倒好评的当下，这番评价随即引发讨论。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292233538727.png
瓦夫拉列出他认为“好故事”应有的要素：复杂且动机明确的角色、内在与外部冲突、自洽的世界观，以及想要传达的主题。他表示，在《GTA6》的演示里没有看到这些。他承认R星做出了一场“精彩的技术演示”，开放世界的规模也前所未有，但认为优点基本止步于此。谈及主角杰森与露西亚，他用词相当尖锐，称两人是“两个无趣的反社会人格者”，为金钱和同类混乱地屠杀无辜民众。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292234161215.jpg
Tech4Gamers在报道中指出，《GTA》系列向来不以复杂剧情见长，重心一直放在开放探索与混乱玩法上，《GTA6》延续了这一路线；同时，本作剧情流程据称长达约80小时，仅凭26分钟的演示就对整体故事下结论，时机未免过早。瓦夫拉本人也提到，这只是演示带来的观感。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292234232845.jpg
作为以历史考据与叙事著称的开发者，瓦夫拉的这番表态被部分玩家视为“技术派”与“故事派”之间的审美分歧。截至目前，R星方面尚未对此作出回应，舆论对此也意见不一。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292235476158.jpg

news.title: 陈丽君生理期吃止痛药滚三层楼梯 获胡军李乃文照顾
news.summary: 近日，越剧演员陈丽君在综艺《大哥小助理》录制期间正逢生理期，痛经到双腿发抖，

content.v: 近日，越剧演员陈丽君在综艺《大哥小助理》录制期间正逢生理期，痛经到双腿发抖，靠吃止痛药硬扛着完成从三层楼梯无保护滚落的高难度表演，台下疼到蜷缩的她一上台便瞬间入戏，展现出极强的职业素养。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_19/194.jpg
录制当天是陈丽君生理期第一天，她痛经难忍、腿部控制困难，只能含蓄向胡军索要止痛药。服用止痛药后她坚持登台，无保护地从18级台阶连续滚落，胳膊肘、胯部实打实磕在台阶上，极易造成多处淤青。台下她疼得趴在桌上缓劲儿，可一上台眼神立刻入戏，两个多小时的演出唱念做打状态稳定，完全看不出正承受生理剧痛。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_19/1244.jpg
胡军起初误以为陈丽君头疼，察觉真相后悄悄拉上李乃文商量对策，两人准备了红糖水和益母草膏，李乃文全程守护她的水杯。胡军坦言滚楼梯动作很容易摔得青一块紫一块，李乃文则感叹她“把自己完全奉献给舞台”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_19/1345.jpg
陈丽君，1992年5月出生于浙江嵊州，浙江小百花越剧团青年演员，一级演员，工小生，师承尹派，浙江省戏剧家协会会员，中国戏剧家协会会员。今年年初，电影《镖人：风起大漠》上映，陈丽君饰演大漠侠女“阿育娅”，将20年越剧武生功底融入打戏，翎子功、毯子功转化为马背杀招，独立完成马背下腰射箭、弯刀格斗等高难度镜头，获得第38届大众电影百花奖“最佳新人”奖。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_19/1347.jpg

news.title: 曝性感旺达已正式回归漫威！超级战力 剧服曝光
news.summary: 近日，知名爆料账号MyTimeToShineHello发文爆料称，旺达·马克西莫夫（绯红女巫）即将正式回归漫威电影宇宙。

content.v: 近日，知名消息人士MyTimeToShineHello（曾准确爆料“三虫同框”）发文爆料称，旺达·马克西莫夫（绯红女巫）正式回归漫威电影宇宙。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292218006537.png
爆料人表示，该角色的演员伊丽莎白·奥尔森的替身日前参与了某项拍摄工作，并且穿着一套与绯红女巫在此前参演电影中所穿服装相同或高度相似的服装。
MyTimeToShineHello直接写道：“Wanda is officially back.”（旺达正式回归。）
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292222032955.png
在此前的故事情节中，旺达为了摧毁黑暗神书并阻止其力量继续影响多元宇宙，主动摧毁了卡马泰姬以及沃尔米尔的黑暗神书。然而影片并没有明确展示她的尸体，因此关于绯红女巫是否真正死亡的讨论一直没有停止。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292222187559.png
作为漫威电影宇宙中公认的顶级战力之一，绯红女巫的实力此前已经得到充分展现。她不仅能够使用混沌魔法改变现实、控制意识，还曾以一己之力压制多名强大的超能力者。如果这次回归属实，那么漫威未来的故事中无疑又将多出一位极具分量的强大战力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292222435906.png
如果此次爆料属实，那么旺达或许将在未来的漫威作品中再次登场。不过目前漫威官方尚未确认伊丽莎白·奥尔森回归，也没有公布这次拍摄对应的具体项目，因此现阶段仍应将其视为未经官方证实的爆料。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292223058237.png
至于旺达究竟会以本体、变体还是其他形式回归，以及她是否会出现在《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》等后续作品中，仍有待官方进一步公布。

news.title: 三成院线片票房不足10万 排片为0的电影如何生存？
news.summary: 据《2026中国电影产业研究报告》，2025年上映的374部国产新片中，有122部票房不足10万元，占比近三成。

content.v: 据《2026中国电影产业研究报告》，2025年上映的374部国产新片中，有122部票房不足10万元，占比近三成。
2025年票房不足10万的国产新片达122部，另有78部票房在10万—100万区间，两者合计占全年上映国产片的53%以上。
同期票房过亿的仅30部，排名第一的《哪吒之魔童闹海》单片揽下超154亿，占全年总票房的近30%。市场呈现“头部极强、尾部极弱”的哑铃型结构。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_18/1196.jpg
其中，《喜欢高兴爱》入围上海国际电影节亚新奖、平遥影展等多项荣誉，上映首日排片0.0%，票房4065元，累计票房不足2万元。导演刘兵感慨“情况比预想的还要严重”。《昏头转向》成本加宣发约1000万，资金来源包括亲友借款和银行300万贷款，最终票房仅5.4万。出品人赵玉琴高烧42度病倒，每日面对债主催债。2026年上映的《夜半怪影》连续11天排片、票房、观众数均为0。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_18/1384.jpg

而反观《牛来》首日票房仅3420元，靠“烂到极致”的猎奇话题出圈，总票房突破5400万，甚至倒逼影院主动加场。《给阿嬷的情书》以95%潮汕方言精准锚定核心受众，首日排片仅3.6%，最终逆袭至20亿票房，排片占比最高达50%以上。《后室》《痴迷》选择头部供给空白期上映，避开合家欢和视效大片重叠赛道，分别收获1.84亿和2.38亿票房。《醉刀客》导演李炳渊公开承诺“不好看退票”，虽票房不到200万，但获得舆论关注，成功让部分影院经理主动排片。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_18/1610.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260829_zy_red_164_18/1613.jpg
以往小片靠网络平台版权、电影频道采买、政府奖励等回收成本，但如今网络版权价格大幅下跌，电影频道采买价格也下调，尾部电影生存空间进一步被压缩。赵玉琴认为“底层人也要发出声音”；刘兵称文艺片是为“找到同道和观众形成艺术探讨”，核心主创均未拿报酬。

news.title: 华为新款手机全部售罄！首款阔直板未发先火
news.summary: 快科技8月29日消息，华为京东自营店显示，华为Pura X View在预订阶段便已全部售罄，所有版本均被抢购一空，人气极为火爆。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292205008523.png
快科技8月29日消息，华为京东自营店显示，华为Pura X View在预订阶段便已全部售罄，所有版本均被抢购一空，人气极为火爆。线下门店同样迎来预订热潮，产品预订量迅速攀升，消费者争相体验这款备受关注的阔直板手机，抢购氛围浓厚。
据悉，华为Pura X View是全球首款阔直板手机，其采用6.39英寸屏幕，显示面积达到114.27平方厘米，比6.9英寸的iPhone 17 Pro Max（快科技注：iPhone 17 Pro Max显示面积为111.55平方厘米）更大。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292205113623.png
不仅如此，华为Pura X View的屏占比高达96.1%，机身厚度仅为6.68毫米，重量为201克。在如此超轻薄的机身内，它塞进了一块7000毫安时的电池，容量比iPhone 17 Pro Max更大，机身却更加轻薄。
更重要的是，相比传统直板手机常采用的20:9比例，华为Pura X View的横向显示面积更大，比例接近小平板或电子书。在观看常见的4:3和16:9视频内容时，画面能够更充分地填充屏幕显示空间。
观看竖屏短视频时，屏幕上下无黑边，内容填得非常满。刷小红书等信息流应用时，较宽的屏幕尺寸也能同时容纳三列内容，信息浏览和搜索效率更高。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292205288642.png
这款新品将于9月7日正式发布，届时会公布最终售价，新机提供幻夜黑、零度白、跃影红和亚麻灰四种配色，全系标配12GB内存，最高提供1TB存储，并预装最新的鸿蒙7操作系统。

news.title: "山寨车鼻祖"7年来首次盈利 众泰整车业务仍未复产！
news.summary: 众泰汽车上半年盈利0.80亿元、七年来首次扭亏，但营收主力仍是配件与门业，整车尚未复产。

content.v: 众泰汽车发布2026年半年报。报告期内公司总营收1.90亿元，同比下滑32.08%；归母净利润同比上涨154.08%，由去年同期亏损1.48亿元转为盈利0.80亿元。这是众泰汽车时隔七年后首次实现盈利。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292144479081.jpg
从收入结构看，报告期内的营收主力仍为汽车配件业务与此前跨界布局的门业，两项合计占整体营收的85%，整车制造相关业务贡献的占比很小。截至半年报披露，公司规模化的整车业务仍未正式复产，上半年仅完成少量来自海外零散订单的整车发运，未启动常态化的大规模整车生产。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292145008046.jpg
在整车业务停摆期间，众泰汽车仍在推进汽车板块的研发投入：上半年相关投入超过千万元，同比增幅接近800%。公司在财报中说明，规划中的全新车型已于今年6月底完成造型冻结，工程数据发布与大部分核心供应商的定点工作同步完成，零部件和整车层面的测试验证正在推进，新项目整体进展符合此前制定的计划。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292148022452.png
众泰汽车被不少网友戏称为“山寨车鼻祖”。截至目前，公司尚未公布规划中新车型的具体量产时间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292148106686.jpg

news.title: IGN6分《瘟疫传说》新作大受好评！画面表现极佳
news.summary: 《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》已于8月28日正式发售，目前游戏在Steam平台收获“特别好评”评价，不少玩家对游戏的画面表现、电影化演出、…

content.v: 由你来说 ： 《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》的口碑走向可谓是频频反转，游戏发售前媒体给出的评价并不统一，IGN只给出6分评价。如今游戏发售后，玩家评价却一路走高，你玩了这款首发XGP的游戏了吗？感觉如何？
《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》已于8月28日正式发售，目前游戏在Steam平台收获“特别好评”评价，不少玩家对游戏的画面表现、电影化演出、音乐等体验给出了较高评价。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292131243966.png
有玩家表示，这正是自己希望在2026年玩到的游戏，认为本作拥有“顶级美术”、电影级画质以及优秀的弱引导，并称其为“今年画面表现力最棒的游戏”，给出了9.5/10的评价。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292131416820.png
另一位玩家则重点称赞了游戏的史诗感配乐、优化以及电影感画面和镜头，认为灵巧的动作设计搭配格挡、弹反机制，虽然战斗并不复杂，但玩起来相当爽快。
也有玩家将本作比作“《战神》＋《古墓丽影》/《神秘海域》”，认为游戏融合了《神秘海域》和《古墓丽影》的遗迹探索与解谜元素。
虽然战斗存在一定重复性，装备养成和系统深度也不如《战神》丰富，但游戏凭借出色的画面、演出以及神话悬疑氛围吸引玩家，剧情推进也较为紧凑。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292129532887.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292132096399.png
《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》由Asobo Studio开发，是《瘟疫传说》系列的新作。本作原创剧情的时间线早于此前获奖的《瘟疫传说》系列故事，玩家将化身索菲亚，前往米诺陶岛，在探索古老秘密的过程中直面神话生物以及凶煞诅咒的源头。
目前来看，本作首发阶段的玩家口碑表现相当不错，尤其是画面、演出、音乐，已经成为玩家评价中的高频关键词。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/29/small_202608292138262988.png
值得一提的是，此前《共鸣：瘟疫传说传承》的媒体评价解禁时的评价并不完全统一，游戏开分时M站PS5版评分79分，Xbox版评分88分，PC版评分84分。
知名媒体IGN为本作打出了6分的评价，认为该作在该系列的基础上做了大量颇具新意的尝试，但其中只有一部分创新取得了不错的效果。

news.title: 我只玩了一个小时的《全面战争：战锤 40,000》，这是我这一年的亮点
news.summary: Living the grimdark dream.

content.v: Creative Assembly dropped a whole bunch of new information about Total War: Warhammer 40,000 at Gamescom this week, and yeah, this all sounds amazing. But what is it actually like to play?

I got an extended look at a preview build yesterday, where I was able to spend an hour exploring a slice of the tutorial, a little bit of the campaign, and finally a huge late-game battle, and oh boy. Folks, it's incredible. Total War: Warhammer 40,000 was, hands down, the coolest thing I saw at Gamescom.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/uqFwZ6mjWcKsFS8rNyEgKQ.jpg
Even in the tutorial battle, which starts you off with only a few Ultramarine units, it's immediately obvious how special Total War 40k is—I don't think a tutorial has ever made me giddy before.

Yes, the massive-scale scraps are one of Total War 40k's big hooks, but the smaller battles are actually great at showing off what sets this game apart from its predecessors. My tiny army of Intercessors—just some basic dudes—ended up feeling as powerful and versatile as a standard, full-featured Total War army.

As the green tide of orks charged towards my position, I stuck my lads behind some cover and opened fire. But they weren't just firing their basic bolt rifles. Units have multiple wargear options, so my small Ultramarine army made up for what it lacked in numbers with the diversity of its arsenal.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/DZxHkA7pBbheMdboy3AsFQ.jpg

Grenades were getting tossed out, for instance, or launched from grenade launchers, leaving big holes in the ork horde. The devastation left behind was stunning. When a few eager orks managed to make it to my fortified position, it became a melee scrum, with my Intercessors proving that they can rack up the kills even when they aren't shooting.
The devastation left behind was stunning.

And that's just the tip of the bloody iceberg. The variety of weapons represents the greater range of tactical decisions you'll need to make, depending on who your enemy is. Against orks, for instance, autos can be handy, letting you mow them down when they come into close range—which is where orks naturally like to be. But if you're fighting the aeldari, you'll benefit from long-range weapons, like the stalker bolt rifle.

Every unit still has a primary function, but this system just nudges them slightly beyond that function, giving them a few more options. So an Intercessor unit might not be the best choice for taking on some light vehicles, but with their grenade launchers they are more than capable of standing their ground and melting metal.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Y4ttF62TVgumAUMcUzH2JQ.jpg

When another group of orks appeared, I decided to call in reinforcements. Assault Intercessors. I aimed their drop pods right at the green mess, so when they landed they took out plenty of extremely surprised orks. Then they just started hacking at them with chainswords, covering their armour in ork blood. In a matter of seconds, the orks were routed.

In the brief campaign slice, I got to create my own Space Marine chapter, decked out in red and gold, which I named the Blood Drinkers. The build didn't contain the full range of customisation options that Creative Assembly is planning—and we can expect even more after launch—but there were still plenty of colour and emblem options.

I didn't get to see much settlement development or management in this portion, as it's not ready for prime time yet, but I was still impressed with just how striking the campaign map looked, with its rotatable 3D planets and, when you zoom out, an entire solar system waiting to be played with. Creative Assembly's artists are firing on all cylinders. These are grimy, imposing worlds that look hostile to all life, but they're simultaneously gorgeous. And busy, too, full of geographical flourishes, gargantuan hive cities, miasma-filled forests, shipwrecks and wandering armies.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/X6BDkwxP8GA5LvnaLGQkGQ.jpg
The campaign slice ended in a medium-sized fight, which I handled quickly because I knew I was running out of time and I desperately wanted to jump into the late-game brawl. I was not disappointed.
Total War 40k is eager to give you all sorts of tactical tricks to keep your warriors alive.

I was playing as the Ultramarines once more, arriving just in time to see the desperate soldiers of the Astra Militarum about to get overrun. While the Space Marines and Astra Militarum are separate playable factions, they are both part of the Imperium of Man, and thus work together. In the campaign, for instance, my settlement was protected by an Astra Militarum garrison.

Anyway! My buddies were in trouble, and the ork army seemed endless. I had some Predator tanks and Dreadnoughts at my disposal, but I was still fielding a tiny force—the rest of my units were up in space, waiting to be called down when needed. In another Total War, I might have been worried. But Total War 40k is eager to give you all sorts of tactical tricks to keep your warriors alive.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3gV2XqSdYzn2ki7NJduoFQ.jpg

The cover system truly is a revelation. This isn't the first Total War to feature cover—that would be Empire —but this time it benefits significantly from an inherent dynamism. As buildings and walls get toppled, your cover disappears, but as the battle progresses you'll encounter new places for your troops to hunker down—a massive crater that just appeared, for example.

A greater focus on defense could have turned Total War 40k into a slightly plodding game, or made it static, even, with entrenched units taking potshots at each other. But the dynamism means that the battlefield is constantly changing shape, so you need to adapt on the fly throughout a fight. It was surprising to see just how much of the battlefield ended up being used. This is easily the most kinetic Total War has ever been.

You'll also have to consider how to beat cover. Positioning has always been critical to Total War's battles, but that truth is so much more pronounced here, when you've got opponents just chilling behind walls or in buildings. Thankfully you're spoiled for choice—you could drop some reinforcements behind them or on top of them; sacrifice some lower tier units as a distraction, while you send some Terminators in to flank the enemy; or you could just go all out, bombing the position or sending a war machine through the wall.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gS9xjQcJyisQhERWz63dKQ.jpg

When Creative Assembly first introduced Total War: Warhammer, there were several game-changing features, but Total War 40k is next level. The Total War fundamentals have been preserved, of course, and I found that my familiarity with the series meant that, even with all the changes and focus on ranged combat, I was still in my element, but not a minute went by without me witnessing something or doing something that I've never experienced in a Total War before.
Total War 40k is next level.

As someone whose dining table often hosts giant battles, I'm primed to love this stuff. I let out an audible whoop when I called in my beefcake Terminators, and watched orks getting completely squished as they walked into beautiful powerfists. Even if 40k isn't really something you've engaged with before, however, you're going to have a blast.

After the demo ended, one thing felt clear to me: I'd just played the future of strategy games. There were just so many "holy shit" moments. I may have only played for an hour, but I got a day's worth of fun out of it. My predilection for cynicism has been stomped by hefty Space Marine boots.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6offQUY4CXebir2TC27dMd.jpg

news.title: 《GTA6》提供无缝快速旅行 包括巴士、火车、出租车等
news.summary: 《GTA6》大量新细节曝光。在一段新视频中，GTA主播TGG讲述了他两个月前参与GTA 6试玩预览时的体验。R星北方联合负责人Rob Nelson确认，游戏中将依赖公共交通工具，让玩家能够在莱昂尼达的不同地点之间快速旅行

content.v: 《GTA6》大量新细节曝光。在一段新视频中，GTA主播TGG讲述了他两个月前参与GTA 6试玩预览时的体验。R星北方联合负责人Rob Nelson确认，游戏中将依赖公共交通工具，让玩家能够在莱昂尼达的不同地点之间快速旅行。
例如，小地图会显示不同的公交车站，你可以在那里等候公交车，这与之前的GTA系列游戏不同，以前你需要在路上拦车。这些公交车可能会沿着特定的路线行驶，并在地图上的其他公交车站停靠。
玩家可以选择跳过旅行时间进行快速旅行，也可以选择欣赏沿途风景，享受更悠闲的旅行体验。
火车或许也是在莱昂尼达快速旅行的一种选择。TGG解释说我们可以乘坐火车，但他不能百分百确定火车是否会让我们跳过旅行时间。
不过，出租车也是我们可以选择的另一种出行方式。此外，还有一款类似Uber的应用程序，叫做“RydeMe”，可以让你在线叫车。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260829/1788009962_461363_jpg_r.jpg
海量细节汇总：
公交车站可以用于快速旅行。你可以在车站等公交车，然后选择完整体验整个乘车过程，也可以跳过乘车过程，直接抵达目的地。
得来速（Drive-thru）功能完全可用。你可以把车开到窗口前，点餐并领取食物，而购买的食物还能暂时提升角色的属性。
《GTA6》中加入了一款名为RideMe的应用，类似Uber或Lyft。你可以叫一名司机，然后选择完整体验这段行程，也可以直接跳过乘车过程。
《GTA6》中有一座动物园，你可以在那里观察和研究不同的动物。Jason和Lucia也可以一起去动物园约会，以提升两人之间的关系。
便利店的互动性更强了。你可以像《荒野大镖客：救赎2》那样，亲手从货架上拿起商品，然后购买。
HUD高度可自定义。默认情况下，小地图、现金等信息只会暂时显示，但你也可以开启经典的常驻小地图，或者改用指南针。
新增快速设置导航点功能，你无需打开地图，就可以直接从游戏世界中选择兴趣点进行导航。地图本身也可以通过PS5手柄的触摸板直接打开。
《GTA6》加入了主播模式（Streamer Mode），可以过滤掉受版权保护的音乐，同时还加入了类似《荒野大镖客：救赎2》的拍照模式。
《荒野大镖客：救赎2》中的电影模式（Cinematic Mode）回归了。开车在游戏世界中移动时，你可以使用电影式的镜头视角。
手机现在变成了真正存在于游戏世界中的实体物品，Jason和Lucia会实际拿起手机查看和使用。两名角色各自拥有不同的应用，也会关注不同的人。
你在社交媒体上看到的视频和帖子可能会引导你前往游戏地图中的实际地点，并找到相关人物。有些在网上发布内容的人，之后还可以在游戏世界中找到。
手机中加入了一款健身应用，它会提醒你什么时候应该锻炼。此外，手机还拥有消息、银行、社交媒体和交通等应用。
一款名为Waink的车辆应用可以提供汽车相关信息，包括需要使用什么工具才能撬开某辆车、车辆的售价，以及登记车辆所需的费用。
你不能随便偷一辆车，然后永久把它变成自己的车。偷来的车辆必须支付费用进行登记，之后才能成为你的个人车辆。
你可以在安全屋里剪发或剃发，而理发店和美发沙龙则能提供更多不同的发型。与《荒野大镖客：救赎2》不同，你不需要等待头发重新长出来，就可以直接选择较长的发型。
NPC互动方式与《荒野大镖客：救赎2》类似，你可以主动向路人打招呼，也可以挑衅他们。不同NPC会根据你的互动方式做出截然不同的反应。
Lucia在自由探索时可以自主保护Jason。在Rockstar的演示中，一名女性在互动后开始推搡Jason，Lucia便自行出手将她打倒。
与《GTA 5》和《荒野大镖客：救赎2》相比，NPC的身高种类现在丰富得多。Rockstar表示，实现这一点在技术上是一个很大的挑战。
游戏世界中的宠物数量也有所增加。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.title: IGN 好评最多的 Nintendo Switch 2 游戏
news.summary: Not all Nintendo games are created equal. Here are the 10 best Nintendo games we've played in the Switch 2 gen

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/01/23/switch2games-1769208267817.jpg

The Switch 2 launched just over a year ago, and we've already gotten our hands on some excellent games . If you're looking for recommendations of what to play on the newest console, we've compiled every Nintendo game that we've given a review score of 8 or above.

While there are tons of amazing games that have already been released on or ported over to the Switch 2, we’re setting some limits by sticking to Nintendo exclusives. These are predominantly first-party games published by Nintendo for either just the Switch 2 or both Switch consoles.
Let’s get into it.
10/10 - Masterpiece
Donkey Kong Bananza
Release Date: July 17, 2025 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: " The leader of the bunch is finally back to kick some tail in Donkey Kong Bananza, a brilliant successor to Super Mario Odyssey and a smashing return for a classic Nintendo character. It was a bold choice to build the Switch 2’s first 3D platformer around Donkey Kong instead of Mario, but it’s proven to be the best decision Nintendo could’ve made. DK’s satisfying, expressive movement and powerful, dynamic abilities create a truly groundbreaking adventure." - Logan Plant
The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom - Switch 2 Edition
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2023/02/08/legend-of-zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom-1663081213439-1675804568959-1675893074772.jpg
Release Date: June 5, 2025 | Read IGN's Original Review or Switch 2 Review Update

From IGN's Review Update: "Not only does The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom still hold up as a game I can’t wait to lose a few dozen more hours in, the updates and additions made to the Switch 2 Edition make it feel like this is the way it was always meant to be played." - Tom Marks
The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Switch 2 Edition
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2020/10/26/01-tloz-botw-1603741775621.jpg
Release Date: June 5, 2025 | Read IGN's Original Review or Switch 2 Review Update

From IGN's Review Update: "This Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is of course an enhanced version with visual upgrades, faster loading times, and support for the Zelda Notes service via the Nintendo Switch App on your mobile device. It’s admittedly a fairly modest upgrade in terms of actual new features or content, but a welcome one, and it makes this undoubtedly the best way to play a sprawling epic that still stands tall as one of the greatest achievements in Nintendo’s iconic adventure series." - Tristan Ogilvie
9/10 - Amazing
Splatoon Raiders
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/07/20/splatoonraiders-blogroll-02-1784569680712.jpg
Release Date: July 23, 2026 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: "Splatoon Raiders is an amazing action RPG with an expertly executed loop. It has fantastic new powers with crazy upgrades that are worth chasing, tough battles that force you to put care into your build in order to overcome them, and a huge variety of fun level types to jump between. The pacing, balance, and difficulty curve are very impressive: I always had to work to get better, but none of the campaign ever felt like grinding or needless padding." - Logan Plant
Pokemon Pokopia
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/02/28/pokemon-pokopia-blogroll-01-1772238090766.jpg
Release Date: March 5, 2026 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: "Pokémon Pokopia is a real treat: an enjoyable building and town simulator that capitalizes on the charming personalities of its monsters in a way that appeals to both the creative and collector alike. It's packed with fun things to do and worthy rewards for doing them, and strikes a healthy balance between freedom and suggestion in its building mechanics (despite a few precision nitpicks)." - Rebekah Valentine
8/10 - Great
Mario Kart World
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/11/1158164-mario-kart-world-un-jeu-de-course-inedit-et-plein-de-nouveautes-annonce-pour-la-nintendo-switch-2-1781165564781.jpg
Release Date: June 5, 2025 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: "The first brand-new Mario Kart in a decade makes huge changes to the established formula, but ironically, the best parts about it closely follow the blueprint of every entry that’s come before: unbeatable local multiplayer racing on well-designed tracks that more than live up to the series’ legacy. World’s tight controls, celebratory soundtrack, and universal polish marvelously complement the action, and I can’t wait to see how top players will take full advantage of its exciting parkour mechanics in the months and years ahead." - Logan Plant
Star Fox
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/09/sfbr-1781027996439.png
Release Date: June 25, 2026 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: "Despite knowing nearly all Star Fox 64’s shortcuts and secrets for close to 30 years now, this remake’s impressive coat of paint and compelling new cutscenes made me smile like I just did my very first barrel roll. Finding hidden routes to unlock different stages or small optimizations to push my score sky high is still much deeper than it first appears, keeping the brief campaign runs fun across multiple playthroughs." - Jada Griffin
Kirby Air Riders
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/11/13/kirbythumbono-1763069064246.jpg
Release Date: November 20, 2025 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: "I’m not sure what’s crazier: the fact that Kirby Air Riders exists, or the fact that it’s this great. It’s a blast in local or online multiplayer during its traditional races and unique battle mode, and its frankly absurd amount of fun achievements to chase, meaningful unlockables, and deep customization makes it great for solo players, too." - Logan Plant
Metroid Prime 4: Beyond
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/11/26/metroid-ign-1764154726610.jpg
Release Date: December 4, 2025 | Read IGN's Full Review

From IGN's Review: "It nails the essential elements of a Prime game that remain special decades later: tense exploration through haunting locations highlighted by amazing worldbuilding, breathtaking art direction, new twists on classic abilities, and flawless technical performance. Even though a few underdeveloped elements keep it from feeling as cohesive as its predecessors, Prime 4 reaches heights worthy of the Metroid name." - Logan Plant
Super Mario Bros. Wonder + Meetup in Bellabel Park - Switch 2 Edition
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/03/24/smb-wonder-meetup-in-bellabel-park-blogroll-1774394148407.jpg
Release Date: March 26, 2026 | Read IGN's Review

From IGN's Review: "It sands off the rough edges of the original version while adding a fantastic lineup of boss battles, endgame challenges, and cooperative levels that each make use of Wonder’s excellent platforming in entirely different ways. The local and online competitive minigames are pretty bland, and I wish it’d gone just a bit further in getting the most out of its exciting new Dual Badge idea, but the rest of this expansion is so polished and inspired that it more than makes up for any shortcomings." - Logan Plant
Blythe (she/her) is an Audience Development Coordinator at IGN who spends way too much time in character customization screens and tracking down collectibles.

news.title: Rockstar 考虑在《侠盗猎车手 6》中设置四个主角，但工作室“担心会减少每个角色的玩家时间”
news.summary: "How do we follow up three characters? Is it four characters now?"

content.v: One of the most intriguing creative decisions Rockstar made with Grand Theft Auto 6 is reducing the number of playable characters from three to two. Since sequels typically operate on the rule of 'bigger is better', the logical progression would have been to add even more playable characters to the roster.

It turns out that Rockstar did indeed consider this. Speaking to IGN , studio co-head Rod Nelson explained that a GTA with four protagonists was on the table. But Rockstar decided against it due to concerns about spreading the player's attention too thin.

"As the narrative unfolds, we're quite conscious to try and make sure that players have enough time with each character," Nelson explained. "After doing GTA 5, we talked about different ideas of 'Do we have more characters? How do we follow up three characters? Is it four characters now?' But we worried about diluting the amount of player time with each, and therefore player connection with those characters."

This fear of diluting that time spent with each character is also what led Rockstar down the path of two protagonists. "The question became: how do you make players feel like 'I love them both'" Nelson adds. "Chemistry is a notoriously hard thing to do in any sort of entertainment. Either the characters and the actors that embody them have it—or they don't."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/5Zd5kjU8aBvReKwbJ323GZ.jpg

Nelson adds that "everyone involved worked at that pretty hard" and believes that the team eventually "got it." Having watched the extended trailer that recently aired on Netflix—the relationship between the two characters was certainly the element that stood out most to me.

For example, there's a moment toward the end of the trailer where Lucia gets beaten up and tossed down a flight of stairs. In the spectrum of horrible things that can happen to a GTA character, this is relatively minor. But I was surprisingly shocked by it, because everything shown up to that point had invested me in Lucia and Jason's relationship—more than I ever felt about any of the characters in Grand Theft Auto 5.

Obviously, there's plenty more to Grand Theft Auto 6 than just its two protagonists, like its world that's three times the size of Red Dead Redemptions 2 's, and the fact it has a more nuanced version of the honor system seen in Rockstar's most recent Wild West adventure. But I increasingly believe it will be that central partnership that defines it over the other GTA games, especially since Rockstar appears to be sticking to the script when it comes to campaign mission design.
