news.title: [更新] 独立开发者在 gamescom 上发布视频报告笔记本电脑被盗事件，CD Projekt Red 等公司介入提供帮助
news.summary: Ryan Laley, the solo indie developer behind upcoming asymmetrical horror game Mimic, has shared a video confir

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/mimic-gamescom-stolen-1787956253274.png
UPDATE AUGUST 29, 2026: Both gamescom and Mimic developer Ryan Laley have responded to IGN's request for comment.

gamescom organizers replied to IGN's email request, pointing to a general statement regarding incidents of theft at this year's show. The same message was also posted to social media. You can read it in its entirety below.

"We are aware of stolen hardware and take these reports very seriously and understand the frustration of affected exhibitors," the message said. "Since many requests reached us, we would like to inform about general security regulations at the event: Uniformed guards provide general security across the venue. Individual stand security can be booked separately, and exhibitors are advised to insure equipment against theft.

"This is noted in the terms and conditions of participation and the technical guidelines. All cases have been reported to us and to the police, and investigations are already underway. We also want to ensure that the reported cases are individual cases, which we are very sorry to read. Because security has one of the highest priorities to us as an event and to see that indie developers are affected makes us very sad.

"At an event of this size, however, there will always be individuals attempting to take advantage of the situation. Our security measures are designed to minimize such risks as effectively as possible."

We are aware of stolen hardware and take these reports very seriously and understand the frustration of affected exhibitors. Since many requests reached us, we would like to inform about general security regulations at the event: Uniformed guards provide general security across…

Laley also replied to IGN's request to learn more about both his stolen equipment and the events that followed. He clarified that it was his Alienware 16X Aurora gaming laptop that was taken, resulting in at least one full day of canceled appointments and missed opportunities. In his own words, it's the kind of thing that can leave a solo deveveloper feeling "isolated and vulnerable."

Thankfully, Laley wasn't alone for too long. After posting his first video following the incident, he was met with a wave of support from the gaming industry. He said he started the day "feeling sick" and "defeated," saying he wanted to "just go home and throw in the towel." He added that seeing everyone lend a hand "warmed my heart greatly."

"Words can't describe it," Laley told us. "I was simply sharing what happened to my existing community as I teach game Dev on YouTube and mentor studios and individuals as my main job. To see the explosion of love and support has been unreal and unbelievable. I'm glad to raise a spotlight to security concerns that other have had too and encourage everyone to look out for each other."
The indie dev has yet to receive any specific updates regarding his stolen gear. He was told he likely won't hear from police for another six weeks.

Laley has received significant support from his peers and fans alike. He asks any others hoping to help him make up lost ground check out Mimic on Steam, while encouraging those interested in development with Unreal technology to head over to his YouTube channel .

"Support the indie Devs," he added. "Making games is hard work, they/we are trying to share our love of this craft. We don't have a budget of some studios and are often paying out of pocket for a lot of this. So please go support the other developers out there too. They deserve it."

ORIGINAL STORY AUGUST 28, 2026: Ryan Laley, the solo indie developer behind upcoming asymmetrical horror game Mimic , has shared a video confirming his gamescom was "cut short" after he and other developers had their laptops stolen.

A teary Laley took to X/Twitter to share a video explaining why his "gamescom is over early," saying that "all our laptops have been stolen" after he and others had their booths "raided" overnight. Bringing Mimic to the Cologne, Germany gaming event meant getting the opportunity to show it off to a new audience of potential partners and eager gamers alike, but stolen gear would bring that dream to an end.
"As an indie, solo dev, this s**t's expensive and hard to do all by yourself," he said. "And to have this happen is beyond frustrating – it's heartbreaking."

My #gamescom cut short. Our equipment was stolen last night from the booth. Police reports have been filed. At a loss for words to describe the feeling. Just defeated. Gonna do my best with what's left of the week. But a huge blow financially and mentally pic.twitter.com/dKpp3Of6df

Laley went on, saying the gamescom theft was reported to the proper security teams and authorities. Despite the effort he and others were putting in, he noted, "I don't expect it, obviously, to be found or returned."
"I don't know what I'm going to do now," he added. "I can't do my job. We'll post updates if I get any updates, but effectively, gamescom is over for me."

gamescom kicked off when Opening Night Live (ONL) aired Tuesday, August 25, letting developers loose for the rest of the week to show what they bring to the table. At the time of this story's publication, there are still more than two days left in the show , making Laley's loss an especially painful one. Thankfully, his story and video gained enough traction to reach the eyes of developers looking to help.

The Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 team at CD Projekt Red quickly chimed in , apologizing to Laley for the circumstances he'd been thrust into. They admitted they wouldn't be able to "help right this second," but they did promise to "send a few things" his way.
"No choom should have to start from zero," its post said.

Gaming industry expert and Don't Scream developer Joe Henson (a.k.a. Indie Game Joe) went as far as to post a video message reply offering his support. It's an offer that Laley seems to have accepted.

Thank you for the support everyone. Long crazy day. I'm still around this weekend if you want to catch up at Gamescom. I'll be boothless but still in my Mimic shirt (a fresh one DW) so come say hi if you see me :) Looking forward to meeting other Devs and trying out their… pic.twitter.com/b0gro1BL0Y
Thank you everyone for outpouring of love and support today! You are the reason why I love this industry ❤️

"Thank you everyone so much for your support and love," he said in a follow-up post. "I'm trying to say thanks to everyone, but honestly, my fingers aren't fast enough. Huge shout-out and thanks to @IndieGameJoe, who kindly donated the money to replace my stolen hardware. He truly is a champion for the little guys, and [I'm] so thankful for his support towards all of us indies!"

Laley returned with an additional post later, thanking everyone again for their support. Although he will no longer have his booth, he still encouraged anyone interested in Mimic to find him at gamescom.

"Words can't describe how much I'm grateful for everyone's support," he said. "I'm a mentor and trainer in Unreal Engine, I train a lot of people up and go to a lot of universities, talk to a lot of students who want to get into games, and one of the things I always say to them is how friendly and warm and supportive of each other it is. Today is just evident of that. Proof that you guys are amazing."

news.title: 技术专家称《侠盗猎车手 6》是迄今为止视觉效果最先进的游戏，这解释了为什么它卡在 30 FPS
news.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally had its first big gameplay reveal, giving us our first real look at Rockstar's

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally had its first big gameplay reveal, giving us our first real look at Rockstar's massive open-world and the amount of detail it holds. It's one that might be the most visually-impressive game we've ever seen, according to the experts at Digital Foundry.

Digital Foundry's Oliver Mackenzie and Richard Leadbetter have praised GTA 6's visual presentation, with Mackenzie specifically going as far to call it the "most impressive example of real-time game rendering" he's ever seen. The pair praised a slew of details showcased in the gameplay, including standout character rendering, especially the hair physics and skin details across not just the game's protagonist, but many NPCs too.

Ray tracing use was also praised, with the pair pointing out how Rockstar has delicately implemented it in the right places for the biggest impact, and is leaning on older conventional methods in the pursuit for a better balance between fidelity and performance.

Performance was a big talking point too, especially so given how poorly GTA 5 performed on Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3 when it initially launched. Rockstar has always seemingly favored the best looking image quality over the smoothest, but that seems to have changed with GTA 6. Digital Foundry noted that while the game was rendering at 30 frames per second, that target seems to be consistently hit, with the team rarely finding dips during its analysis of all 48,242 frames.

According to Digital Foundry's calculations , the gameplay preview of GTA 6 was rendering at a native 1440p and then upscaled to 4K without using a modern upscaling technique, leading to a slightly soft image that can hopefully be improved before launch. The team also reaffirmed its prediction for several months ago, saying that it doesn't expect Rockstar to release a 60fps performance mode for GTA 6 on this generation of consoles, even with significant compromises to the outstanding visual presentation on offer.

It expects the PlayStation 5 Pro to offer better examples of ray-traced effects or potentially higher resolution targets, but the CPU remains the biggest bottleneck in a world with so much simulation that would make halving the rendering time nigh impossible without a significantly more capable processor. That's something that a PC release in the future might showcase.

There are so many details packed into the Grand Theft Auto 6 showcase that you might have missed, so make sure to check out our biggest takeways from the presentation , including the return of a six-star wanted level , how you can pet (and scold) dogs around the city , some of the references fans are already picking up , and how you won't need to engage with the game's love story if you don't want to .

news.title: 泄露的 DLSS 5 Mod 显示了 Nvidia 的 AI 过滤器会对您的游戏产生多大​​的干扰
news.summary: Nvidia hasn't yet announced a release date for DLSS 5 , which it revealed to widespread backlash earlier this

content.v: Nvidia hasn't yet announced a release date for DLSS 5 , which it revealed to widespread backlash earlier this year. But a recent leak has provided PC modders the ability to inject the neural rendering in almost any game, which is being used to showcase just how awful its AI-powered face filters can get.

Accidentally included in a build of NBA 2K27 (via VideoCardz ), an early version of DLSS 5 was accessed and made useable by the RenoDX modding community, who quickly developed a crude toolset allowing anyone to use the suite across a variety of games. These ranged from extensive tests on Control , Cyberpunk 2077 , The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim , and even Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas , each showcasing some of the benefits and the many, many drawbacks of the heavily AI-reliant post-processing that Nvidia plans to introduce.

Control is one of the most interesting examples as it offers good looks at both sides of the coin. When toggled on, protagonist Jesse Faden's character model definitely looks more detailed, gaining more facial shadowing and detailing across the skin's surface. But it also makes her look quite different to the original model, sticking out even more in motion as you navigate through a world that is unevenly enhanced in the same way. There are clear benefits to some environmental details, especially some models that are starting to show their age. But it just looks unnatural in so many ways, clearly showcasing how just minor blemishes can make a whole scene feel incohesive.

Another interesting example is Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, particularly because of how old the game is. Back when DLSS 5 was announced, Nvidia defending the technology by stating that it was simply enhancing geometry already present in a game, and not fundamentally altering it. It was difficult to take at face value then given the examples, but it completely breaks down when looking at how much it alters a PlayStation 2 title. You'd be hard pressed to find anyone who thinks this is a superior-looking version of the Rockstar classic, which makes sweeping changes to character and environmental models that just look wrong.

The ability to test this neural-rendering suite out has also been eye-opening in terms of how it performs. Modders using DLSS 5 have managed to get it working across various RTX 50- and 40-series cards, but across the board, performance takes a massive hit with the filters turned on. As expected, the consumes a massive amount of GPU VRAM as its models run locally to make conversions in real astime, sometimes halving frame rates in the process, too. This is obviously an early version not intended for public release, and will certainly be optimized further. But it confirms some fears from its initial reveal, where the tech was running on multiple RTX 5090s.

Nvidia released DLSS 4.5 during Gamescom this week, introducing the next generation of Ray Reconstruction to improve image quality in supported ray-traced and path-traced games. DLSS 5 is expected to launch later in 2026, although Nvidia has not spoken about it significantly since its reveal. In one of its last messages, Nvidia stressed that game developers will have full control over the post processing effect and how much it can alter a scene, while several developers spoke out against its existence .

news.title: NBA 2K27 迄今为止的评论
news.summary: So far, new features have put a spotlight on longstanding issues.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/nba-2k27-1787944622105.jpg

Every year, the NBA 2K series, like our favorite NBA teams, teases enough improvements to give us a sliver of hope; a renewed sense of faith that maybe things will be even better than last time. Although that faith was rewarded last year, that hasn’t been the case in the 10 hours I’ve spent with NBA 2K27 so far. While the on-court play does feel better thanks to smoother and more responsive defensive movements, some new features, like MyCareer Eras, are the opposite. Instead, they act like magnifiers, placing a spotlight on issues that have consistently plagued this series, like an ever-growing emphasis on microtransactions. That can turn what should be an energizing session of hoops into a tiring exercise in scrutiny.

Let’s kick things off with the good stuff: the on-court experience. Offense, although it still feels largely the same, has a few new tricks up its sleeve that make it slightly more challenging than last year. For starters, Rhythm Shooting is much less forgiving than in 2K26 since you’ll have to actually hit the green part of your shot meter to make jumpers. Full disclosure: I religiously use the square button to shoot because it’s what I’ve been doing since 2K10. With this change, I've become even more partial to the classic hold-and-release method since there just doesn’t seem to be an incentive to master Rhythm Shooting’s more finicky timing and down-up motion. Of course, there may come a point when I’ll need to really dig into the latter, but today is not that day.
What I Said About Last Year's NBA 2K26

Belief and disappointment go hand in hand; just ask any sports fan. The crushing blow of losing lingers, but is eventually replaced by a newfound fervor – a flicker of hope that maybe this time things will be different. With the NBA 2K series, it’s mostly been frustrating in recent years because we so often end up being disappointed. Thankfully, NBA 2K26 bucks that trend with a MyCareer mode (for my money the star and core of each annual game) is the best it’s been in years thanks to its amazing prelude storyline. And like a group of reliable role players, a handful of tweaks, most notably the updated shot meter and player movement, tie everything together nicely so that the gameplay in each mode is less stressful and more rewarding. Of course, these excellent improvements make the imperfections stand out, with MyGM continuing to stick out like disgruntled benchwarmers. Overall, NBA 2K26 is the equivalent of a team that’s a few pieces away from contending, making this year’s catchphrase, “Ball Over Everything,” pretty fitting if you don’t count the endless microtransactions in all the online modes. Because when you’ve got the core performing this well, and all eyes are on the on-court action, it becomes easier to ignore those imperfections. – Nicoe Vergara, September 13, 2024
Score: 8
Read the full NBA 2K26 review.

Then there’s the new logic-based Dunk Meter, which, instead of only showing up when you perform Skill Dunks like in 2K26, now appears whenever you drive to and attempt a shot at the rim. The goal, as always, is to hit the green, but it won’t always be that simple, because this feature takes the defender’s positioning into account. That means even if you get a near-perfect release on your way to a jam, a well-timed contest from a towering, highly-rated defender like Zach Edey or Victor Wembanyama could turn it into a miss.

I’ll admit, taking the Dunk Meter into account did take some getting used to, meaning I’ve missed more than a few slams in trying to master it. But after playing several matches, I’ve come to appreciate the greater sense of realism it lends to 2K27. As much as I would want every poster dunk attempt to go in, even a strong and sure-handed player like Giannis can and should get stuffed at the rim every now and then.

That, of course, leads me to the side of the ball that flusters dribblers, causes turnovers, and wins championships. If last year’s defense was a benchwarmer who barely played any minutes, this year it’s the Most Improved Player. As soon as I hopped into a match, the change felt immediate; being near a defender and putting a hand up actually altered a shot! Gone are the dark days when every jumper, even contested ones, felt like they would go in; now that both sides of the ball are balanced, playing through an entire match, at least in the offline modes, feels better than ever.

Now it’s time to head on over to MyCareer’s neck of the woods, with its latest single-player journey, dramatically titled Fire and Concrete. Like always, this tale follows our recurring hero MP, showing his hoops growth in stages from humble high school roots all the way to a career in the pros. Unlike its predecessors, though, this one’s a doozy, spanning 11 chapters – and bigger always means better, right? Right? Oh, if only that were true.

As soon as I jumped into the thick of things, some flaws immediately stood out, beginning with the story itself. Early on, a key plot point is rushed through in an animated vignette instead of actually unfolding in a motion-captured cutscene, as if it were a commercial as opposed to a career-defining incident. It flashes by so fast that I almost missed it, and makes the start of MP’s journey, arguably the most important part, feel like an afterthought.

Then, there’s MP himself, who, so far, has been very hard to root for. It’s like all the personality has been sucked out of this version of him and given to the supporting characters instead. That said, I am still only in the first half of the story, so our protagonist could eventually experience some much-needed personal growth as the rest of it unfolds. But right now, I’d rather be playing as his funny cousin Cam, voiced and mocapped by Vince Staples, who steals the spotlight in every scene he’s in with his quick one-liners and witty comebacks.

Being the narrative nerd that I am, you’d think my biggest frustration would lie with Fire and Concrete’s lackluster story. Well, it doesn't. Instead, what I’ve been most disappointed with so far is MyCareer Eras, a new mode that lets you drop a created player into one of the six significant time periods in the NBA. Sounds exciting, right? I mean, it does on paper. But then you realize that creating more than one custom character means having to begin with a paltry 60 overall rating each time . So, if you want to actually compete in these Eras, you’ll have to either grind out a crazy amount of matches in The City or spend real money to give your characters an immediate boost.

You might be asking, “Why don’t you just use your upgraded Fire and Concrete player in Eras?” Well, the answer is I can’t. Once you start a save file in the story mode, that player is essentially locked to the Modern Era. You also can’t switch from one era to another, which means if you want to try out all of the time periods, you’ll need to make six separate characters. Do you see my problem now? I didn’t think it was possible, but with this mode, developer Visual Concepts has somehow made microtransactions even more glaring and obnoxious than ever.

news.title: Rockstar 向 Netflix 寻求独家 GTA 6 加长版外观，而不是相反
news.summary: The big Grand Theft Auto 6 extended look (mostly) went off without a hitch, and apparently, it was Rockstar Ga

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/06/gtaonothumb-1786018055324.png
The big Grand Theft Auto 6 extended look ( mostly ) went off without a hitch, and apparently, it was Rockstar Games' idea to bring it to Netflix in the first place, not the other way around.

Amidst the unprecedented amount of hype for GTA 6, there was a fair amount of confusion from fans, who questioned Rockstar's decision to make its gameplay debut a Netflix exclusive for six hours after its premiere yesterday. This first real look at Jason and Lucia's story definitely managed to wow viewers, but even after 27 minutes of Vice City, the question remained: Why Netflix?

Many assumed it to be a high-value deal cooked up by the streaming giant to pull eyes its way, but apparently, that's not the case. A Rockstar PR representative told Kinda Funny Games ahead of the big reveal that it was actually the GTA 6 developer's idea to stream the extended look on Netflix. The quote is: "We wanted to go to Netflix."

It's a response that may generate more questions than answers. Rockstar first raised eyebrows when it confirmed plans to bring GTA 6: Extended Look exclusively to Netflix earlier this month, promising what eventually turned out to be a lengthy version of a long-awaited third trailer – but only for subscribers. Even with the knowledge that the full presentation would eventually drop on YouTube just a few hours later, fans who have been waiting 13 years for the next Grand Theft Auto were annoyed to hear they'd have to wait even longer if they didn't want to fork over the cash.

"This is unbelievably scummy," said one fan on X at the time. "Everyone is excited for the extended look of GTA 6, but it's premiering on Netflix first, which will influence people to get a subscription. This needs to be called out, because if any other studio, such as Bethesda, did this, they would be crucified."

Still, some were willing to be patient and see if there might be something more to Rockstar's grand plan. At least some of the hesitation then turned to excitement after Strauss Zelnick, CEO of parent company Take-Two Interactive, promised that the extended look would be worth the price for early admission .

He went as far as to say that the plan was "an example of Rockstar trying new things" as marketing for GTA 6 truly kicked off. He also told Bloomberg , "I think when the title is launched on Netflix, if you watch it, you'll understand more."
"If you're not a Netflix subscriber, you definitely should be one," he told IGN at the time. "And as for the trailer itself, it's coming soon enough that I'll let you arrive at your own conclusion."

Well, the trailer is here, and while it certainly managed to impress, it's still not clear why Rockstar felt the need to bring GTA 6: Extended Look to Netflix, specifically. That said, there are still months to go before launch arrives. Nothing about the developer's future marketing plans has been revealed yet, so it's possible we could see other entries or even episodes added to Extended Look in the future.

For now, though, all we know is that Rockstar has its reasons. IGN got an early peak at all things GTA 6 ahead of yesterday's gameplay reveal and walked away just about as impressed as everyone else. You can check out our thoughts in our preview , and then be sure to see what we had to ask the developer in our interview . You can also check out 69 details we learned while visiting Rockstar HQ , the GTA Online character who's making a comeback , and the Red Dead Redemption 2 Easter Egg hidden in the extended look .

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

There’s tons of new footage from Fable that you can check out from gamescom — plus, read our preview — but I was particularly drawn to these 18 minutes of quest gameplay that takes the Hero through the massive and gorgeous Bowerstone (130 homes and 30 businesses and you can go in all of them??? ), highlights some character interactions (I also would have thrown the beer at Humphry), and shows off a tiny bit of combat (I scrubbed back on shooting that one thug in the knee with an arrow like three times, very good).
Fable releases on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC on February 23, 2027.
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered + Songs of the Past DLC

The Witcher 3 got a twofer out of gamescom 2026: a remaster trailer (which will be free for players who already own the game ) and the Songs of the Past DLC. Any excuse to hang out with Geralt another time is cool in my book. The Remaster, of course, looks super slick, but Songs of the Past especially has me intrigued with the freakiness of Letten.
The Witcher 3 Remaster is available September 29; the Songs of the Past DLC does not currently have a release window.
Final Fantasy VII Revelation gameplay trailer

The Weapons! Are! Here! The FFVII Revelation look out of gamescom — the first since SGF — was fairly short, focusing mostly on those giant monsters, but it did show off more of the aerial and submarine combat that’s coming in the trilogy-ending FFVII remake. Hell yeah, brother.
Final Fantasy VII Revelation comes out in spring 2027.
No Law

No Law was a fun gamescom reveal — it’s an FPS where you play as the field-tested, now peace-seeking Grey Harker. I don’t know much else about what it’s actually about, but I do know that this tongue-in-cheek, cyber-noir, gadget-driven stealth game that also lets you blow some heads off seems pretty dang fun.
No Law releases on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC in 2027.
Pokémon Tales: The Misadventures of Sirfetch’d and Pichu
First teaser for Aardman's stop-motion POKÉMON’ series ‘THE MISADVENTURES OF SIRFEITCH'D & PICHU’. Releasing in 2027. pic.twitter.com/6Wx7pGDb9J

Legendary animation studio Aardman (the folks behind Wallace & Gromit, Shaun the Sheep, Chicken Run, and more) revealed the first teaser for the upcoming stop-motion Sirfetch’d and Pichu teamup series at PokémonXP and holy crap, does it look super cute.
The Misadventures of Sirfetch’d and Pichu releases in 2027 on Disney+.
Ali G: Who Iz I?
Did we really need the return of Ali G in 2026? I dunno, probably not. Would I have preferred a Borat 3? I mean, yeah. Either way, Sacha Baron Cohen has another Ali G movie coming out this fall.
Ali G: Who Iz I? releases in theaters October 23.
Possible Love

POSSIBLE LOVE, a new film from Lee Chang-dong, acclaimed director of Burning and Secret Sunshine, is South Korea's Official Selection for International Feature Film at the 99th Academy Awards®. Two married couples cross paths to film a documentary that causes them to face their… pic.twitter.com/IKxrLsTtKW

Lee Chang-dong hasn’t made a film since 2018’s Burning. His latest, which Lee has said is 10 years in the making, has already been selected as South Korea’s Oscars entry for Best International Feature. Just from the trailer (and an excellent directorial track record; I mean, have you seen Secret Sunshine?), it’s not hard to see why Lee’s film was selected. If I feel devastated after two minutes, imagine what the power of two hours holds!
Possible Love releases in select theaters October 23 before it comes to Netflix on November 6.
Fjord

This year’s Palme d’Or winner is finally crossing over to the states (and is already among extremely early whispers about Oscar nominations). The subject matter in Cristian Mungiu’s film is unpleasant: Sebastian Stan and Renate Reinsve’s family, with their five young children, is on the verge of being torn apart from allegations of physical abuse. Still, I’m eager to watch; Reinsve and Stan are both incredible performers.
Fjord releases in theaters October 9.
The History of Concrete
Learn to love again. John Wilson’s THE HISTORY OF CONCRETE is in theaters starting September 18. #TheHistoryofConcrete pic.twitter.com/Qp2lDBm8d4

Were you a fan of the HBO show How To With John Wilson a couple years back? Were you sad when it ended? If you, like me, fall into this category, you’ll be delighted to know that Wilson has made a feature-length documentary called The History of Concrete that premiered at Sundance and is apparently very good. It finally got a trailer this week and it looks perfectly John Wilson-y.
The History of Concrete gets a limited release in theaters September 18.
Get Jiro

First trailer for the ‘GET JIRO’ animated series. The series follows a sushi chef in a dystopian version of LA where customers resort to murder to secure a table at major restaurants. Releasing October 3 on Adult Swim. pic.twitter.com/V0Pc2LTVCK

This one’s a fun surprise: Based on the 2012 graphic novel from Joel Rose and the late Anthony Bourdain (whose biopic Tony you should see), Get Jiro is a violent animated series from DC Studios about a sushi chef who chops the head off of a customer who uses soy sauce when he explicitly said not to and grates the face off another chef (they probably also deserved it).
Get Jiro premieres on Adult Swim October 3 and streams on HBO Max the following day.
Unabomber

To understand the hunt, you have to understand the mind. Inspired by true events, UNABOMBER stars Russell Crowe, Jacob Tremblay, Annabelle Wallis, and Shailene Woodley. September 25. pic.twitter.com/iJTumS10Tx

This upcoming Netflix movie — starring Jacob Tremblay as Ted Kaczynski, plus Shailene Woodley and Russell Crowe — gives off big "just-OK limited series" vibes, so I’m somewhat skeptical that this'll be any good. But I’m also dumb enough to give it a try.

news.title: PS Portal 优惠 42%，这是您在手持设备上玩 Grand Theft Auto 6 的唯一方式

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/psportalgta6-1787942588804.jpg

Grand Theft Auto 6 is out in November, but only for two platforms: PlayStation 5 and Xbox. That means you won't be able to play it on a handheld gaming PC or Switch 2 portable console for quite a while. If you do want to play Grand Theft Auto on a mobile type device from the comfort of your bed or couch away from the TV, the only easy way will be by using a PlayStation Portal connected to your PS5 console Fortunately, there's a way to get a massive discount on one today.
Xbox gamers can do the same with Xbox Ally using Remote Play, but the cost to own both devices is greater.
PlayStation Portal (Used: Very Good) for $147

Amazon Resale just dropped the price of the "Used: Very Good" PS Portal to $146.99 after a 30% off coupon that's automatically applied during checkout. This is an excellent deal considering the fact that Sony raised the retail price of the PS Portal from $200 to $250 just a few months ago . Amazon Resale is Amazon's official outlet for used items. Amazon states that this "Very Good" item "looks and functions as if it were new. Item may not come in original packaging." You still get the 30-day Amazon return policy so it's a much safer option than buying a used controller off Facebook Marketplace.
Grand Theft Auto 6 will undoubtedly be the biggest game release of 2026

GTA 6 has a confirmed release date of November 19, and I'm pretty convinced that no other game will be played on PlayStation or Xbox consoles in the days following. Just recently there has been a flood of new content for the game from our own exclusive interviews, Gamescom 2026 , and Netflix's exclusive extended look . This game will be the biggest release of 2026 and it is totally worth getting a PlayStation Portal for just one game if that game happens to be Grand Theft Auto 6.

The PS Portal, Sony's handheld gaming accessory for the PS5 console , looks very much like an extended split-pad DualSense controller with an 8-inch 1080p LCD screen in the middle of it. It turns your PS5 into a gaming handheld by letting you stream games from your console at up to 60fps. The controller mirrors the same features found on the DualSense, including haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, and a touchscreen interface that replaces the Dualsense's touchpad. The Portal can stream your games even when you're outside of your home, with the caveat that you have access to very stable, very fast internet connection. Keep in mind that the PS Portal is not a standalone device. This is strictly a remote player for the PlayStation 5, so you will need a PS5 to use it.

You no longer need a PS5 to play games on the PS Portal . Now, rather than being limited to simply streaming games from a $500 console to a $200 handheld, Sony has introduced a feature that lets owners stream games directly from its PlayStation Now cloud streaming service. No PS5 required. Portal owners can either connect the Portal to their PS5 or directly to Sony’s cloud servers (with some new quality of life beta updates that launched in April ). Choose the latter and suddenly you have access to a library of more than 120 games, including Ghost of Tsushima, Resident Evil 3 Remake, The Last of Us Part 1 Remastered, and Marvel’s Spider-Man: Miles Morales. It’s worth noting you must be a subscriber to the highest tier of PlayStation Plus , but $18 a month is much more attractive than paying for every new game.

It should be said that the PlayStation Portal isn’t the only way to stream your PS5 games over Wi-Fi within your home. You can mimic its functionality by downloading the PS Remote Play app on a mobile device, including other gaming handhelds like the Steam Deck. That said, it's more complicated to set up and you'll lose out on some of the DualSense's features.

news.title: 《神鬼寓言》开发者对推迟到 2027 年以避免“混乱窗口”感到高兴，我们都知道这意味着 GTA 6
news.summary: Microsoft's new Fable game was supposed to launch this year, but it was delayed to February 2027. The game's d

content.v: Microsoft's new Fable game was supposed to launch this year, but it was delayed to February 2027. The game's director, Ralph Fulton, said in an interview that he feels "great" about the launch timing for Fable, adding that shifting to 2027 helps the game avoid the "chaotic window" of its original timeframe of late 2026.

Speaking to IGN , Fulton said the reason for the delay "is pretty apparent to everybody." He said he was "really looking forward to" launching Fable in 2026, saying he wasn't happy about having another all-hands meeting with the team in January to tell them, "This is the year we ship Fable." But alas, that's what happened.

"The rationale for it is absolutely sound. I'm glad that we're avoiding that chaotic window," he said. In getting pushed to February 2027, Fable avoids launching near Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (October 23) and GTA 6 (November 19).

Fulton did not mention GTA 6 by name in this interview, but he did previously. In June, Fulton said Fable being delayed to 2027 helps Fable avoid a "really congested period" for game releases and "obviously avoiding Grand Theft Auto."
"Having a much less contested window allows us the opportunity to go out and really make a moment for ourselves, and I think the attention this game deserves,” he said.
Gameplay combat footage from Fable emerged online this week from Gamescom, and it looked rough, but GameSpot's own hands-on time with the game told a different story .
Fable launches February 23, 2027 for Xbox Series X|S, PS5, and PC.

content.v: GTA 6 takes place in Vice City, which is a stand-in for Miami, and it appears the game will feature a Miami apartment building from a popular TV show.

Eagle-eyed fans noticed that Dexter Morgan's apartment in Miami from the TV show Dexter appears to be in GTA 6. The TV show is set in Miami and the exterior shots were filmed at the Bay Harbor Club condos in Miami . You can see comparison images below.
Others have pointed out that by the time GTA 6 releases in November, the second season of Dexter Resurrection will be airing.

Some have theorized that they might find someone who looks like Dexter Morgan walking around Vice City, or that the game might satirize the character or the show. That remains to be seen, but Rockstar's Rob Nelson said told IGN that the developer is being "careful" about what it chooses to satirize to avoid the game coming across as feeling dated. That's part of the reason why GTA 6 is not going to satirize US President Donald Trump or the COVID-19 pandemic .

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. We learned a lot more about the game today, including how the map is 3X bigger than Red Dead Redemption 2’s and that a playthrough can be 80 hours long . The game also brings back six-star wanted levels and you can pet the dog .

news.title: 回合制战术游戏粉丝突然吃得很好
news.summary: The XCOM series has been effectively on hiatus for many years now, and AAA turn-based-tactics games have been

content.v: The XCOM series has been effectively on hiatus for many years now, and AAA turn-based-tactics games have been pretty hard to come by recently. That's changing, however, starting with this week's launch of Star Wars Zero Company . It's effectively a marriage of classic XCOM gameplay and Clone Wars-era Star Wars storytelling, and within a few minutes of starting it, I got that same rush of excitement I got the first time I played an XCOM game.

Typically, I try to savor turn-based tactical experiences like this as much as possible, because I know it's going to be at least a few years before something like it comes along again. The last XCOM-esque turn-based-tactics game I can even recall playing was Classified: France '44 , which released well over two years ago. I enjoyed that one so much that I considered just starting it over again, because there wasn't really anything else like it releasing at the time.

But no longer! As part of Gamescom Opening Night Live , Ubisoft revealed Rainbow 6 Tactics . Ditching the first-person-shooter gameplay the series is famous for, Rainbow 6 Tactics is a single-player tactical experience that plays out like a turn-based version of Rainbow Six Siege. You scout enemy positions using drones and then launch your attack, breaching walls and taking down enemies with precision and force.

It makes use of the destructible environments Rainbow Six Siege is famous for, but it's all wrapped up in a completely different genre. And just like Zero Company, Rainbow 6 Tactics will be available on Xbox and PS5 in addition to PC, giving it a wide audience when it arrives in 2027.

And if you don't have an Xbox, a PS5, or PC, you're still not being left out of the fun as of late. Sure, it's also an RPG, but Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is certainly going to scratch that turn-based-strategy itch. Developer Intelligent Systems is arguably the king of the genre, and based on our hands-on preview of the game, it looks to be absolutely packed with content. There are four protagonists, each with their own stories, so this could be one you are playing for weeks or even months--hopefully just long enough for Rainbow 6 Tactics to be out.

Patiently waiting our turn for the next XCOM-like or Fire Emblem game to release used to feel like a futile exercise, but I'm very excited for the future of sort-of-but-not-really-chess games right now. If others feel the same, we just need to show up and buy them so the genre can keep thriving … and maybe convince Take-Two to greenlight an XCOM 3. Pretty please?

news.title: [更新] EA Motive 在社交媒体上传播游戏预告片后确认《钢铁侠》游戏泄露
news.summary: Gameplay footage from what appears to be EA Motive Studio's Iron Man game has leaked online.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/ea-motive-iron-man-game-leak-1787936702334.png
UPDATE AUGUST 28, 2026: EA has confirmed the Iron Man game leak is real, teasing that it has "a lot more to show" in the future.

The publisher confirmed Motive Studio's Iron Man game leaked online today in a statement sent to Kotaku . It also directed viewers to a new X/Twitter account created in the aftermath of the leak. You can see its first post below.
"Well, that didn't go as planned," EA's post said. "But now you know, and we've got a lot more to show you. See you when we're ready."
Well, that didn't go as planned. But now you know, and we've got a lot more to show you. See you when we’re ready. pic.twitter.com/tU4TtUoZYZ
ORIGINAL STORY: Gameplay footage from what appears to be EA Motive Studio's Iron Man game has leaked online.

Video for what seems to be EA's long-in-development Iron Man game started circulating on social media today. It's a bit more than a few cobbled-together clips, too, showing a (very unfinished) project that features not only Tony Stark's Iron Man, but what seem to be a S.H.I.E.L.D. helicarrier and potentially other characters that Marvel fans may recognize.

The footage, which appeaers to be part of a trailer from an early-in-development build, looks like the kind of thing you'd expect from an Iron Man game. Tony can be seen flying under bridges and through city streets, beating up armored bad guys in between shots of him tinkering on new suit technology, giving the impression that EA Motive is crafting something that will have players traveling around the world.

The allegedly leaked footage for the Iron Man game promises that players will be shooting missiles, using arm-mounted lasers, and throwing missiles at tanks. We won't share any of that here, but if the footage does turn out to be real, it would seem rumors that Motive's Iron Man game was canceled have been greatly exaggerated.

Interestingly, this isn't even the first time this week footage for an unfinished Iron Man game found its way on the net. Monday, video for what seemed to be Avalanche Studios' Iron Man game also surfaced online . It's a different project that was rumored to be in development in the early 2010s before its eventual cancellation. While that team's vision will never see the light of day, nothing is suggesting EA's Iron Man will meet the same fate.

Motive officially revealed its take on the character almost exactly four years ago in 2022. Despite the immense amount of hype the Dead Space remake and Star Wars: Squadrons developer managed to generate at the time, things have been distressingly quiet since.

Our last real update arrived in April 2024, when the team reassured fans that its Iron Man game remained an "important priority" as EA brought it in to work on Battlefield 6. With little else besides a teaser image to keep fans occupied, some had started to worry the team's Marvel project may have kicked the can. However, for now, the game is still officially considered to very much be in development.

"In parallel, development continues to move forward on our Iron Man project, led by Olivier Proulx (Executive Producer) and Ian Frazier (Creative Director)," Motive general manager Patrick Klaus said in 2024. "The team made excellent progress this year, hitting a major internal milestone and laying a robust foundation for the journey ahead. Iron Man is an important priority for Motive, and I’m very proud of the work we’ve accomplished so far."

While it's unclear when footage from today's supposed leak would have been captured, it suggests Motive has been steadily moving along behind the scenes. In an environment where fans clamor for Spider-Man and Wolverine video games, an Iron Man game could (hopefully) have a lot of potential. EA had no comment to share when contacted by IGN.

While we wait for updates as Motive hammers away at its Iron Man game, you can check out the Tony Stark-themed popcorn buckets revealed for the upcoming Avengers: Endgame re-release . You can also check out our review of the VR game that released in 2020 .

news.title: 《GTA 6》的漫长等待让人们意识到自己的死亡
news.summary: You might expect people to talk about the visuals, lighting, action sequences, or gunplay after Grand Theft Au

content.v: You might expect people to talk about the visuals, lighting, action sequences, or gunplay after Grand Theft Auto VI's brand-new extended-look trailer showed off over 25 minutes of new footage. But the top comments on Rockstar's YouTube upload of the video deal more with the human condition than expected. In fact, there's quite a bit of talk about death and remembrance.

The top comment (at the time of publication) states: "a moment of silence for people that didn't make it here." Meanwhile, another person writes: "Objective: Stay alive till release day." It's been a long wait for GTA 6 , especially since GTA 5 originally launched almost 13 years ago.

Not only has a lot happened to the gaming industry as a whole since GTA 5 came out, but also to people's personal lives. For instance, another person typed: "Bro, I went through middle school, high school, and college ... now I need to request time off work for this." Tragedy has apparently struck others, but not dampered their spirits, as seen in this comment: "I was in a traffic accident in February and lost a leg, but I've still got my two damn hands and my eyes, baby!"

There is a lot to take in from the new GTA 6 trailer , such as NPCs noticing if you're openly carrying a weapon in the game. In addition, stealing a car might be a little more complicated this time around. For older vehicles, you can still smash the glass, but newer models apparently require a key cloner.
GTA 6 is set to finally release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It sounds like a playthrough of the open-world game could be roughly 80 hours , so plan accordingly this holiday season.

news.title: GTA 6 让你向人扔狗屎
news.summary: A very important piece of news has come to light about GTA 6 : You can pick up dog poop and throw it at people

content.v: A very important piece of news has come to light about GTA 6 : You can pick up dog poop and throw it at people in the upcoming open-world crime game.
YouTuber TGG visited Rockstar North's offices and spoke with the team, and one of the things he learned was how dog poop can be a weapon.

"If someone is out on the street and they're walking their dog, and the dog takes a dump, you can wait for the person to pick up the dog sh** with a doggie bag, and then you can hit that person, making them drop that doggie bag full of dog crap, and then you can actually pick that up and throw it at people," he said.

Throwing dog poop at people is not a nice thing to do, and presumably GTA 6's new Red Dead Redemption 2-like honor system will knock you for this, or at least we hope it would. GTA 6 also lets you pet dogs or scold them , and we're hoping anyone who scolds a very good boy also gets a ding to their honor.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-28-at-12.03.00-PM.png

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and it's coming to market with an enormous amount of hype behind it. GTA 6 is expected to sell many millions of copies--so many that preorders alone could pay for the game's entire development budget .

news.title: GTA 6：您需要了解的全新大型预告片的所有最大要点
news.summary: Rockstar finally lifted the veil on GTA 6 during a high-profile Netflix event on August 27. The nearly 30-minu

content.v: Rockstar finally lifted the veil on GTA 6 during a high-profile Netflix event on August 27. The nearly 30-minute video revealed a lot . We saw main characters Jason and Lucia in action in snippets of multiple different missions, while there were cutscenes and character interactions on display as well.

The broadcast also featured a new look at some of the updated gameplay systems, like how NPCs will notice if you're carrying a weapon in public , how stealing cars works , and that the game has a Red Dead Redemption 2-style honor system .

There were numerous other details big and small to be gleaned from the reveal, along with interviews from developers at Rockstar North. Check out GameSpot's video below in which Jake Dekker runs through 29 different things we noticed in GTA 6 from the big new trailer, and I'm guessing we found some stuff you didn't notice right away. Check out the video below to see it all.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. There is likely going to be a PC edition of the game, but no one should expect it at launch .

While Rockstar Games has shown off GTA 6's single-player, the developer has yet to utter a word about anything regarding an online multiplayer mode . GTA 5's GTA Online has been, and continues to be, a huge success for Rockstar, so it only stands to reason that Rockstar would lean into multiplayer for GTA 6 as well.

news.title: 游戏拉近你我｜机事本8.22~8.28
news.summary: 【机事本】是机核文章区的栏目，每周五更新。每周五下班之前，我们会收集几位编辑的“小作文”，题材随意，立意自选，栏目名取自Windows系统自带的最轻便的文本编辑器，代表“轻便与畅快” 本周出场人物：柏亚舟 白广大 引擎

content.v: 【机事本】是机核文章区的栏目，每周五更新。每周五下班之前，我们会收集几位编辑的“小作文”，题材随意，立意自选，栏目名取自Windows系统自带的最轻便的文本编辑器，代表“轻便与畅快”
本周出场人物：柏亚舟 白广大 引擎
柏亚舟：巴别塔
科隆的展前发布会上，主持人Geoff不免感慨，我们正处在一个艰难的阶段，游戏行业面临裁员浪潮，游戏玩家要应对硬件普遍涨价，但依然有这么多的开发者，他们依然在持续创造茫茫多优秀作品，然后来到这里相聚。
https://image.gcores.com/e4fa97e9385ff6d6629967cf5f9a9dd0-1440-1080.jpg
其实Geoff说得还不够大，我们甚至可以说，世间纷纷扰扰，只有游戏在让我们团结。这几天的Koelnmesse，几乎就是一座具象的巴别塔，两年前我就有过这样的感受，今年的感受更加明显。
也许原因之一就是中国游戏又变多了，根据不完全统计，这次来了72家中国游戏公司，这还没有算上投资关系，我老是说自己不喜欢国产游戏目前面对的「超级红利」和「超级黑利」现象，总说所有游戏都要统一标准、要好玩，但真正看到同胞们的「超级展台」有来自世界各地的玩家大排长龙，内心没有多余的情感也是不可能的。
除了多，这次来的国产游戏类型也全。在展期发布会，前面几个游戏播片之后，我和翟睿甚至发出了「前面有几个非国产」的感慨，我原本有点担心偏见的存在，但打开科隆官方的油管频道，下面的评论提及的都是游戏本身，而非国籍，偶尔能看见一些质疑，但点赞数还不如「Bring Valko Back」的情愿多。
也感谢AI，实时交流的提速，在这次展会上感受非常明显。在to b展台这边，人们的交流比以往还要热烈，还要人满为患，处处可见小圆桌，以及小圆桌周围认真的讨论；to c展台这边，陌生人因为cos服装、因为熟悉道具打招呼，成了真正意义上的「游戏拉近你我」。
我就遇到了一个背着两米长金箍棒的老哥，一开始还不是很确定是金箍棒，直到我发现倒着的篆体「棒」和「箍」两个字，我说嘿你喜欢《黑神话：悟空》吗，他说当然！于是就有了这张合影。
https://image.gcores.com/70f5a75915781b0bb185ba768dcb2239-1080-1440.jpg
一代一代的人都想修巴别塔，但在绝大多数年代，隔阂、误解乃至冲突才是主流。游戏本无意背负这些，但游戏又创造了一种可能。
白广大：G-Buddy 和 GTA6
首先推荐一位机组的新朋友。
之前我vibe过一个机组日历的小功能，但后来发现对服务器严重不友好，就下架了。现在我们机组用户自己做的这个小机器人有了“那年今日”的全部功能，而且进入页面还可以把它当做一个普通的AI来使用，有一些我们机核自己的熟梗在里面。在此感谢这位创造了G-Buddy的机核用户！
另外说一下今天早上醒来就看见了GTA6 从网线里伸出来的铁拳，看了最新的26分钟演示片，实在是有点按捺不住了，人类游戏工业顶级的“提升密度”的奇观，或许空前绝后。
但是这里又涉及到另一个事情，就是PS5 Pro的涨价曲线。
https://image.gcores.com/e5f0acbd0f24843b185e75a06e44bfe3-1280-960.png

索尼首席执行官户冢弘树对PlayStation主机成本上涨并不特别担忧。在接受《华尔街日报》最新采访时，他表示内存短缺来得正是时候。在PS5经历数次涨价后，该公司计划将重心放在PS Plus订阅用户身上，而非硬件营销。4月份的最新一轮PS5涨价将光盘版的建议零售价从600美元上调至650美元。与此同时，数字版的售价从500美元涨至600美元，而PS5 Pro的售价也从750美元涨至900美元。 该制造商将人工智能数据中心的扩张与存储和内存成本上涨联系在一起。
当前在小黄鱼上的基础价格为：
https://image.gcores.com/13aa0b9eaaebf2a7637f7408909ac58d-1080-2147.jpg
可谓强而有力，简称强力。而在Rockstar 方面来看，《GTA 6》首发不登陆PC平台的原因是：“如果先做PC版本，主机版本就很容易烂尾”。
John Ricchio在播客KIWI TALKZ中表示：Rockstar并非"不在乎PC玩家"，而是基于游戏开发流程的技术考量，Rockstar早期的游戏开发多采用PC优先策略，团队会在性能最强大的PC硬件上进行开发，最后再将成品缩减并移植至规格较低的家用主机。然而这种做法往往导致开发尾声阶段，团队必须耗费大量精力在性能有限的主机上进行移植优化，甚至因此造成糟糕的主机移植品质。
https://image.gcores.com/05be24a892f0730eb85416b2a4e7f038-1280-720.png
好好好。
然而，从GTA3开始，Rockstar的策略就从来都是： 需求曲线永远卡在"略高于主流、远低于顶级"的甜点区； 主机先行 7—19 个月、PC 版做"第二波"硬件消费潮； 媒体装机文、厂商捆绑促销、网吧换代连续勾引； 每代 GTA 都是此后 3—5 年的跑分参照器。
GTA5可以横跨PS3到PS5的世代，不是没道理的。今年2月的报导：Take-Two Interactive 在最新一季的财报中披露，《三男一狗》的累计销量已达到2.25亿份，相比上一份财报中公布的2.2 亿份再次增长，又卖了500万份。考虑到地球上的80 亿人里有手机的大约 56 亿，没有手机（尤其是没有智能手机）的还有 20 多亿人。
每当硬件代际切换需要一个"让亿万人心甘情愿掏钱的理由"，GTA 就是那个理由。因此Rockstar宣布要让新作卖出50亿美元应该不是问题。
但是还有另外一个因素：过去一年是人类半导体科技发展彻底抛弃游戏的一年。AI 数据中心需求把 DRAM/NAND 产能瞬间掏干，民用内存一年涨 3–5 倍、固态一年涨 2–3 倍，直接后果是游戏 PC 装机成本近乎翻倍、玩家推迟升级甚至放弃 DIY。这可能是家用游戏 PC 市场二十年来第一次集体"用不起内存和硬盘"。
祝福Rockstar，请大家多多使用G-Buddy。
引擎：18 点 55 分的机核网
引擎瘫在白色塑料椅子上，腰部空着，脸冲着窗户，撇了眼手机，现在是18点55分。
18点55分，从20层高楼往下看，立交桥上的路灯会同时点亮。一整排的编辑工位空无一人。
https://image.gcores.com/278ac921c5c86ee207f3b5335c05a313-3024-4032.jpeg
Jerry挂着证件，在场馆里四处奔走，身边有人在说德语，他可能不知道，科隆在下雨。
四十二在家，双手飞快地敲击着键盘，顾不上因病而麻木的右手，因为互联网捎来了甲方的需求。
豆哥在讲日语，不禁思考地按下了电梯上的按钮，他比门口那个背着黑色双肩包，焦急等电梯的小哥还要熟悉大楼的布局。因为这里是史克威尔在东京新宿的办公大楼。
白老师在远处，被两台屏幕包围，一台竖着。光头在反射屏幕的光。
萝卜的工位上传来劣质键盘噼啪作响的敲击，一把三十五包邮的键盘一字一字敲出的是最新一期的故事节目。
“走，录。”萝卜冲我招呼。
空调会在18点59分准时关闭。我的静息心率是99。
男厕所左数第三个池子，会在冲水时爆发出如丰水期的壶口瀑布一般的声响。
而现在是22点36分，我要在十分钟内，上交一篇记事本！！！

news.title: Sabre Boss 对实体游戏的消亡和游戏机价格上涨的反应
news.summary: 2026 has been full of big storylines in gaming, including Sony's announcement that it will end support for phy

content.v: 2026 has been full of big storylines in gaming, including Sony's announcement that it will end support for physical PlayStation game discs in 2028 and the trend of consoles getting increasingly expensive. Tim Willits, the chief creative officer at Saber Interactive, caught up with GameSpot at Gamescom this week to discuss these topics and offer up a bizarre-sounding possibility for an "AI box" for games.

He said he was "surprised how upset people were" about Sony ending support for physical game discs. Willits said he hasn't bought a physical game "in a long time" because he enjoys the convenience of digital games. Willits is not alone, as the share of digital game sales is growing at numerous companies.

At the same time, Sony continues to sell millions of physical game discs annually . Willits said Saber still makes "a lot of money" from physical games, especially in Europe, but the trends are different in North America, he observed.

Willits went on to say he had an interaction with someone recently who asked him to sign a copy of Doom 3, a game he worked on when he was with id Software. "So for me personally, I'll miss that in the future," he said.
An AI game box?
Part of what many people enjoy about physical games is collecting the boxes they come in and presenting them on their shelves.
Willits said he thinks someone in the future might create some kind of "AI box" into which players can "upload all your games."
"So maybe someone will do that," he said.
Rising console prices

Another major storyline in gaming in 2026 has been how video game consoles today are more expensive than ever . There are numerous reasons for this, including US President Donald Trump's tariffs, the AI-fueled impact on component and memory prices, and more.

Sony and Microsoft raised prices on PlayStation and Xbox consoles so much that the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S consoles are now $150+ more expensive than they were when they launched in 2020. Nintendo, meanwhile, is hiking the price of the Switch 2 in September.

For his part, Willits said it's "shocking how expensive" it has become to buy a new console today, adding that it will "be interesting to see" how Sony and Microsoft manage this as they look to release new consoles.

A new report from Ampere Analysis said that if next-gen consoles do, in fact, come in at $1,000 or more, that could have a dramatic, negative effect on the market. To be sure, Sony and Microsoft have yet to detail their plans for new consoles, so there is no word yet on how much they might cost or when they could be release.
In other news, Willits told GameSpot more about the company’s plans to use AI in game development and how the company claims it will never fire anyone and replace them with AI .

content.v: 在ChinaJoy期间，我有幸参加了一场《异克斯小队》的线下试玩，也就是最近在科隆游戏展上放出新片的三人联机PVE动作射击游戏。
哪怕把游戏本身放在一边，作为一次线下闭门试玩来说，也是体验不错的。出于其三人联机PVE的本质，我与另外两位来自其他媒体的老师组成了一队，由我担任队长，一起简单体验了这款游戏，结下了战友情。是的，我们这个行业偶尔也是能出现一些同行情谊的。
《异克斯小队》由加拿大知名团队 Behaviour Interactive研发，国内由腾讯游戏发行，STC游戏产品部合作出品。海外由 Level Infinite 发行，TEAM SHOOTER & CREATIVE合作出品。游戏将于2027 年登陆 PC / PS5 / Xbox Series X|S，并在即日起开放愿望单。
该作的制作人以及核心团队有着丰富的3A游戏制作经验，参加过《孤岛惊魂2》，《彩虹六号：异种》《全境封锁》《刺客信条》等作品的开发。
悲催的打工人，在异形遍布的行星表面上作战
媒体老师们被分为三人一组，组队开始游戏。我与一名有一定游戏经验的同行老师，以及一名几乎没有动作射击游戏经验的媒体老师组成了小队，先从低难度开始体验。
https://image.gcores.com/28858b78bcc5e1fae2dbccde33d494bd-828-466.png
在这个三人成行的游戏模式里，玩家在出发之前要先由队长选择任务目标，这将决定前往的星球，难度，以及任务目标和敌人种类。然后大家再选择这次出击要配备的装备，包括主武器，特殊武器，道具，以及最重要的：武器上的模组。
我们一开始被禁止使用任何模组，因为模组十分强力，大家先从未装模组的朴素武器开始体验，这时我很轻易联想到了《星际战甲》的模组系统。但是后来体验到本作的模组系统后，意识到也不尽一样。
三人出发进入地图后，随时与“公司总部”保持通讯，队长打开地图之后标记位置，全队一起向目标进发。沿途有充满敌意的野生生物前来阻挠，也被我们的步枪轻松解决。至于敌人本身，很难用某种地球生物来把他们简单类比，只能形容为各种奇怪的外星动物，攻击方式也多种多样。有的喜欢突脸，有的喜欢在远处默默对玩家蓄个大的。
玩家之间也存在足额的友军伤害，一不注意就会打死自己人。打死自己人之后，可以使用一个复活枪把一个新的队友“射到”目标位置，同时在目标位置还会形成爆炸，杀伤范围内的其他队友或敌人，并把刚复活的队友投入险境。
玩家扮演的角色名为“Exterminauts”，这个词是由“灭害”和“宇航员”融合而成，基本也代表了玩家的核心任务：消灭生物，完成公司指定的工作。
来到任务地点后，通常就是一些非常简单的疏通，激活，防守类的工作，完成一项工作就可以前往下一个地点，也有许多支线任务供玩家选择。时不时地图上会突然弹出一个存在时间任务的临时任务，想要拿到奖励的话就要立刻前往。这种任务的本质是你的老板突然决定让你“加个班”。
https://image.gcores.com/814aee487caa40739f39abd8a1c3d65f-828-466.png
https://image.gcores.com/39463b0fc6d1d36601ffe6a94f0132cf-828-466.png
在这个简单难度里，我们体验到了与《绝地潜兵2》类似的玩法流程，而更多的差异性体验随着难度的提高逐渐浮出水面。
在中等难度下，大家开始研究给武器装什么模组。游戏提供了丰富的构筑方案，在稍微研究之后我给自己构筑了一套以暴击触发特效为核心思路的模组，而我的队友则构筑了一套以治疗和生存为主的玩法。再次进入游戏后，随着我一梭子子弹打到大型怪物身上，许多酸液，闪电，火焰开始迸发，特效满天飞，原本很肉的敌人在我的build面前被瞬间融化，感受到了一种数值上的爽快。
https://image.gcores.com/334748502db813b9f3bcc1b9f7b2aecd-828-466.png
而我那个生存治疗构筑的队友基本失去了杀伤能力，但是凭借极强的治疗效率跟在我身边给我补血，我们基本上组成了一种输出与治疗的强强配合。这种相对“极化”的构筑体验让我意识到这也许是这个游戏的核心乐趣，这个乐趣主要来自于武器模组的选择和配合，而制作团队也说，这些模组不会难以获得，或者让大家肝很久才能得到。
在撤离阶段，地图上的敌人会来围攻撤离点，这个时候三位队员可以比赛谁杀的更多，屏幕上会出现一个计分板。我自己杀够了全队总分数的95%，可见正确的模组构筑的重要性。
除此之外，玩家在游戏内可以获得弹药和物资的补给，但这些补给也是要花公司预算的，而这个预算会从玩家这次任务的工资里扣除，那么如何用最少的资源完成任务来赚取更多的利润也成了玩家要考虑的问题。
https://image.gcores.com/a3917273287ac54805e7a4fad047ba97-828-466.png
勇敢的打工人，在大企业的压迫下维持生活
在《异克斯小队》里，玩家也服从一家超大法西斯组织（为啥要说“也”）。
《异克斯小队》的故事发生在遥远的天穹星（Tian）。这颗星球上发现了一种全新的奇迹能源“多态等离子体”，引爆了一场席卷星际巨头的“淘金热”，也带动了开采、精炼与运输技术的飞速发展。然而这种物质对于许多异形生物来说如同蜜糖一般诱人，于是企业与生物之间的战争愈演愈烈，玩家们置身其中，又要完成开采任务，又要消灭异形生物。
https://image.gcores.com/31213df77528965e75261e3bd66be692-828-466.png
https://image.gcores.com/121a500e1b979df5429176dbf62dc7f7-828-466.png

在美术方面，玩家拥有自定义宇航服的丰富选项，但大部分设计思路都围绕着“蓝领”这个主题展开，荧光黄色的醒目配色在欧美人看来就是工人制服特有的颜色，所以许多宇航服也都是这种包含工地元素的服装。从硬质安全帽、护目面罩、隔音耳罩、呼吸防护面具，到绑带、护垫、反光条、耐磨工作手套、随手可取的工具袋、连体工装和安全靴，装备清一色是一线劳保防护用品，细节拉满。原因也很实在：在遍地异种、险象环生的异星上，把自己保护好，永远是第一要务。
https://image.gcores.com/8c9f4e7a30769bd70e1cab621b4adfee-828-466.png
而武器方面，除了工人们防身使用的步枪，冲锋枪，霰弹枪等，真正的大杀器反而是一个个“工具”。比如原本用来冷冻和稳定环境的冷冻器，在玩家的小小“超载”之后，可以发射出相当惊人的巨型冷冻气体，一瞬间把目光所及范围内的一切变成冰雪世界，包括喜欢乱动的可怕敌人，以及你无辜的队友。相信我，发射超载冰冻炮的那一刹那，视觉效果真的很炸裂。
https://image.gcores.com/8ae76b740314bfeba1d12acfd83f25e5-828-466.png
要想超载这些工具让他们的发射变得无比强大，需要从玩家的电池里汲取一些电力。这些电力除了可以超载武器，也可以用来超载一些“谜题”，直接跳过谜题交互完成任务，大幅加速任务进程。是把电力用在消灭敌人上，还是用在消灭解谜流程上，就看三人的配合了。
也正是这些风味化的设计，一定程度上拉开了与《绝地潜兵》等竞品的体验，找到了属于自己的风格。
强大的打工人，最终会赚个盆满钵满……吗
https://image.gcores.com/97399c4dbf1d47b383692268e8fafb95-828-466.png
最后，是与发行团队的一些简单沟通，以及我的一些思考。

在他们看来，这是一款想要塑造“蓝领英雄”的游戏，开发灵感来自许多作品，比如《捉鬼敢死队》《黑衣人》《异形》《绝世天劫》等。这些作品中的主角都不是超人，没有超能力——他们像《绝世天劫》里的蓝领工人一样，粗犷、务实，拥有厉害的技术和武器，对资本主义、权力和高层管理抱有不信任感。他们直率、甚至有些粗犷和暴力，但也非常可爱和直接。他们的生存环境是高压的打工环境——长时间工作、需要薪酬回报、不断加班、被资本主义压榨。这些乍一听似乎都能切中当下的时代性。
但是在两个小时不到的游玩里，由于游玩时间有限以及没能从头开始游戏，并没有太能感受到那种非常代入的，为黑心大企业卖命的氛围，主角三人所做的工作也没让我觉得充斥着所谓的“蓝领”气质。要想充分感受到这部分是否做的优秀，还得花更多时间游玩正式版本。
我对发行团队负责人说：《绝地潜兵2》以及其他同类游戏的成功并不在于他真的把战斗玩法做的多有趣，而是只要我打开游戏就能身临其境，为了“超级地球”或者“帝皇”，我就可以无数次再开一把这些游戏。如果《异克斯小队》在这方面下足功夫，那就能真正戳中我的好球区。
但话又说回来，我所举的这些例子的确也都是已经有许多年的社区耕耘之后的结果了。要想在这个赛道上用一个全新IP抢一杯羹，难度自然是相当大。
要想让玩家切实感受到与自己控制的打工人的共情和相互鼓励，一定要去找真正的打工人，去找各行各业一线奋战的真正打工人来取取经，了解他们的思考方式和工作上的困境，只有这样才能在氛围和叙事上闯出自己的一片天。
另外，这款游戏也有他自己的“绝活”，那就是在长线运营方面非常清晰的自我认知，他们决定狠狠的“卷”（误用）一把同行竞品们。
以目前发行方规划的想法是，这款游戏将会以每三个月为一个赛季，不同主题、不同运营活动；每六周一个Battle Pass，包含新皮肤、新武器、职业模块，以及多样化的活动等。
我认为，只要更新频率够快够勤，内容够多，玩家自然会愿意经常回来玩一玩。
最后，在售价方面，这款游戏的售价不会高于同类产品。
完整版暂时计划于明年发布，但综上所述，如果你是一个喜欢三人合作PVE动作射击游戏的玩家，这是一款值得保持关注和期待的作品，等到正式发售后可以再看一看。
https://image.gcores.com/61bea3ea4c1c1756197bc2011982efdd-828-466.png

news.title: Gears Of War: E-Day 有一个受大逃杀启发的 PvP 模式，你可以在其中剥掉敌人的肉
news.summary: Gears of War games have had some of the best multiplayer action around ever since the days of the first game,

content.v: Gears of War games have had some of the best multiplayer action around ever since the days of the first game, and for Gears of War: E-Day , developers at The Coalition are looking to give fans plenty of options for online fun. While the game's new take on Horde mode is shaping up to be the ultimate battlefield for players to enter, fans of traditional deathmatches aren't being left out in the cold either. At Gamescom, The Coalition spoke to GameSpot about E-Day's new Crucible mode and how it uses some battle royale inspiration to create a fast-paced round of 4v4 action.

The PvP mode blends your typical Gears of War spatial control with battle royale mechanics, as teams must grab the Power Core, bring it to a designated active zone, and hold their position while the opposition closes in on them. The catch is that the Power Core restricts your mobility and limits which weapons you can use, meaning that your team will need to watch your back. The core stores a close-range electrical charge attack, and the carrier can unleash a charged blast at point-blank range to fry an enemy player, but this attack does have a long recharge time. Once the Power Core enters the scoring zone, it will begin to shrink. This, in turn, creates high-stakes zone pressure, forcing players into brutal standoffs as the space around them tightens.

"It's very obviously inspired by battle royale games, but it's on a Gear-sized PVP map," creative director Matt Searcy said to GameSpot. "At the beginning of the map, there's lots of mobility, teams are moving around, you're trading the Power Core back and forth. But as the map goes on, you see defensive teams start to build up a front around the player they're protecting. And then, in awesome Gears fashion, the thing you're going to hold puts you at a slight disadvantage. So we gave you a heavy weapon that's basically a giant battery pack, and if somebody gets close to you within a really tight range, you can strip all the flesh off their body with a charge attack."

Crucible is one of four PvP modes that will be available on launch day. The multiplayer options include traditional Team Deathmatch, Conquest, and Demolition, each of which has been reworked for E-Day. Team Deathmatch has a dynamic respawn system to move spawn locations closer to where fights are breaking out, Conquest puts its own spin on the classic King of the Hill experience, and Demolition revolves around teams planting bombs on enemy territory.

Gears of War: E-Day launches on October 6 for Xbox Series X|S and PC, and it'll also be a day-one release through Xbox Game Pass. For more on the game, you can read up on how The Coalition solved its biggest lore problem.

news.title: 《湮灭之潮》斩获科隆游戏展「最具史诗感」大奖：国产单机游戏惊艳世界舞台
news.summary: 8月28日，由日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）研发并发行的国产单机动作冒险游戏《湮灭之潮》，在 2026 科隆游戏展大奖（gamescom award 2026）颁奖典礼上正式摘得「最具史诗感」（T

content.v: 8月28日，由日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）研发并发行的国产单机动作冒险游戏《湮灭之潮》，在 2026 科隆游戏展大奖（gamescom award 2026）颁奖典礼上正式摘得「最具史诗感」（The Most Epic Game）大奖。这款出自成都团队的处女作，力压《红色沙漠》（Crimson Desert）、《战锤40K》（Warhammer 40K）等国际 IP 胜出。
https://image.gcores.com/8f3091b9195c56ec451b7df6a462c652-1920-1080.jpg
力压国际大作，成都团队首作扬威科隆
gamescom award 由德国数字游戏文化基金会主办，是全球最大游戏盛会科隆游戏展的官方奖项。值得关注的是，「最具史诗感」大奖的往届得主中不乏全球顶级 IP：《塞尔达传说》《怪物猎人：荒野》《生化危机：安魂曲》均曾摘得此桂冠，《湮灭之潮》此番能从中突围，含金量不言而喻。
https://image.gcores.com/6f322adaa6c36e6c890a01e2ddb057f7-1920-1281.jpg
继全新宣传片「旧日之纱」于开幕夜直播（Opening Night Live）首映、并于科隆展览中心 6 号馆 B-050 展位迎来公开试玩之后，本作凭借酣畅淋漓的战斗体验、电影级的演出品质、独特的幻影骑士系统与史诗级 Boss 战，征服了到场媒体与玩家。将亚瑟王传奇融入「异世界入侵下的破碎伦敦」的独特设定，正是这一殊荣的最佳注脚。
从格雯德琳的情感旅程，到召唤圆桌骑士对抗半神
“科隆游戏展是行业内最具影响力的展会之一。我们能在这里获得『最具史诗感』大奖，感到非常荣幸。”《湮灭之潮》游戏监制陈琦表示，“从开发之初，我们的目标就是以中国团队的视角，改编亚瑟王经典。这座奖杯，是对我们开发团队辛勤付出、创造力与热情的极大肯定。在众多优秀的提名作品能最终胜出，我们倍感鼓舞，不胜感激。”
https://image.gcores.com/76870173b85ba4181698cdf80977d605-1920-1441.jpg
自《黑神话：悟空》之后，《湮灭之潮》成为又一款在科隆游戏展斩获大奖的国产单机游戏。从成都东郊记忆的千人试玩会，到德国科隆 gamescom 的领奖台，《湮灭之潮》正将它的瑰奇幻想带向更广阔的世界。
https://image.gcores.com/c48a1cafea3c96ed52ba980d66d245fb-1920-1441.jpg
《湮灭之潮》是一款日蚀边缘工作室研发并发行的国产单机买断制骑士幻想动作冒险游戏。游戏基于虚幻 5 引擎打造，仅登录 PC 及主机平台，游戏以「异世界入侵下的破碎伦敦」为核心设定，玩家将扮演灾难中的幸存者格雯德琳（Gwendolyn），在现实与幻境交织的伦敦废墟中展开冒险，对抗由异世界而来的威胁，并逐步揭开世界倾覆背后的秘密。
《湮灭之潮》现正面向 PC（Steam 与 Epic Games Store）、PlayStation 及 XBOX 平台开发中。
https://image.gcores.com/3293e6e5999d7b92d0d6ab760cc0708e-1920-1437.jpg

日蚀边缘工作室（Eclipse Glow Games）是一家面向全球玩家开发及发行 PC 和主机游戏的工作室，总部位于四川成都。工作室当前正在开发基于亚瑟王神话的动作冒险游戏《湮灭之潮》，团队由 150 余名开发者组成，成员曾参与《如龙》（Yakuza）《荣耀战魂》（For Honor）《刺客信条》（Assassin's Creed）《女神异闻录》（Persona）与《波斯王子》（Prince of Persia）等知名游戏的研发。

news.title: Sabre回应拼车游戏中人工智能的批评并承诺，“我们永远不会解雇某人并用人工智能取代他们”
news.summary: One of the biggest talking points in gaming today is the use of artificial intelligence, including generative

content.v: One of the biggest talking points in gaming today is the use of artificial intelligence, including generative AI. It's a hot-button issue, and few companies have faced the level of criticism about it as Saber has. The developer recently found itself in hot water after CEO Matthew Karch lashed out at Rideshare Stimulator's former writer who said they were laid off and replaced by ChatGPT.
Now, Saber's chief creative officer, Tim Willits, has addressed the situation as well, promising that, "We will never fire someone and replace them with AI."

For anyone just catching up, Rideshare Stimulator is an upcoming Saber game where players take on the role of an Uber- or Lyft-like driver and interact with them as they take them to their location. The developers freely admit to using generative AI in various capacities, and now Willits has shed more light on the situation. He said the game's main campaign features dialogue written by humans, but there is also a "free ride" mode where Rideshare Stimulator wants to be able to reference current events in the real world.
"We use AI to generate that because we want to do it so fast," Willits said, adding that the plan is for weekly or biweekly updates with this kind of AI-generated content.

Willits also clarified that some of Saber's other games, including the new Hellraiser, Turok, Stuntman, and Space Marine games, also do not use AI. Saber, like many other game companies, is experimenting with AI in various ways.

"We want to figure this new technology out, and we don't know exactly where it's gonna go, and our players don't know where it's gonna go, so we're all ... all of us are trying as a society to figure this out together," he said. "We want to experiment with it. I personally believe somebody [at] some game company will come up with such a brilliant idea, and we'll all be like, 'That's it.' We just need to get there."

When asked specifically about claims that Saber is firing people and replacing them with AI, Willits said this is not true. "I promise you we have never let anyone go and replaced them with AI. We hire people all the time," he said.

A spokesperson for Saber previously told PC Gamer that neither Saber nor Rideshare developer Unigine replaced any writers with AI for that game or any others. "In fact, Saber's staff of writers has tripled since 2023. Rideshare's story was written entirely by real people," the company said.
Rideshare's "experimental, free-ride mode" does use generative AI "by necessity," Saber said, because "the number of passengers in the game is infinite."

"We are firm believers in using AI tools to improve or enhance gameplay experiences and improve NPC behavior as we have done since Saber was founded in 2001. As the industry has continued to contract, Saber continues to hire. None of our 3000+ employees have to worry about being replaced by AI," the developer said.

The writer in question, Stella Sacco, said Karch reached out to "apologize unreservedly" for how he spoke about Sacco. Karch had said , "Stella who? I had to ask Claude because I have never spoken to her or seen her."
Sacco added in a statement that Karch said "he regretted escalating and how people online were speaking about me."

"I'm not worried about being called slurs by random commenters--I'm a trans woman; that's every day for me. But it stunk to have my skill and reputation built of 20 years in games publicly maligned by someone with institutional power."

news.title: 《猛鬼追魂》：复兴不仅仅是修士和血腥——我们从 Saber Interactive 学到的 10 件事
news.summary: October wouldn't feel right without a spooky game or two, and Hellraiser: Revival is shaping up to be a terrif

content.v: October wouldn't feel right without a spooky game or two, and Hellraiser: Revival is shaping up to be a terrifying-- and horny --dive into the nightmarish fiction of author Clive Barker. So far, the game is looking like the kind of Hellraiser experience that defined the franchise throughout the '80s and early '90s, and at Gamescom, Saber Interactive sat down with GameSpot to talk about the game, how far they're willing to go to nail the vibe of Hellraiser , and more.
Hellraiser: Revival launches for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S on October 6.
Cliver Barker was a "permissive" partner

The legendary creator of Hellraiser needed some convincing before he started collaborating with Saber Interactive, but once he was assured that the developers had a grasp of the Hellraiser franchise, he gave the studio the freedom to tell their own tale within that dark universe. "Clive Barker was such a permissive partner to work with," narrative director Anthony De Fault said. "He was really supportive of our ideas. He basically just wanted to make sure we understood Hellraiser as a franchise, and then, once he knew that we had the, we were channeling the same spirit that he was channeling back in the '80s, he just let us go."
Capturing the soul of Hellraiser's greatest hits

For the game, Saber Interactive aimed to capture the "soul" of the franchise, drawing not only from the recognizable visual elements established in the Hellraiser movies, but also from Clive Barker's original novella, The Hellbound Heart, which served as the source material for the franchise. "This game is a response, specifically to The Hellbound Heart, the first film, and Hellbound: Hellraiser 2, the second film," de Fault said. "So it's just the things that Clive was involved with that resonated really strongly with people back then. We wanted to make something that renewed that and had the same soul, but for a new medium and 40 years later."

Barker was also credited as an executive producer on the third and fourth Hellraiser movies, but had no active production or creative involvement in the franchise until 2022's Hellraiser reboot. That gap saw six Hellraiser movies released, although fans usually consider this period a low point for the franchise.
Saber Interactive isn't afraid of pushing ratings boards to the limits

From what we've seen so far, Hellraiser: Revival looks like it'll be going all in on the extreme subject matter of Barker's work. Saber Interactive has confirmed that the game is going to be gory and sexy, as the studio didn't want to compromise on their vision--even if that meant it faced the risk of being denied classification in several regions. Why go that far? Because doing anything less was seen as a disservice to Hellraiser fans.

"We knew what Hellraiser ought to be. We knew how disappointed Hellraiser fans would be if we did compromise, so it was just never really on the table," de Fault explained. "We wanted to pitch it at a point where I don't know if the executives would necessarily have agreed with this at the time, but we always felt like, if we get denied a rating in one or two places, we've probably done our job right. It was just important to us to do everything with purpose. All of the depraved stuff that you might encounter in the game, I think everything in there is defensible in terms of there's a reason it's there. It's not just for shock value. "It's like a good discomfort."
"Comforting discomfort," Esov added. So far, it looks like the game will be available in the US, at least, as it has received an ESRB rating .
It was all about execution

While all of that comforting discomfort is designed with a purpose in mind, don't be too surprised if Hellraiser: Revival makes you reach for a bucket. One scene in particular might be hard to stomach, as de Fault described it as a moment of "consensual mutilation" in the game.

"There's a consensual mutilation scene. In early versions of this, we failed to adequately convey to players that this was consensual. So, some people came away thinking it wasn't and that it was pretty distressing, and so we had to course-correct that. I think our intent was fully realized in the game. There wasn't really anything we wanted to do that we scaled back or anything like that. We just had to correct the execution in some places."
Hellraiser: Revival takes place in the ancient year of 2006

Hellraiser: Revival is set in 2006, in the small town of Claireport. Saber Interactive chose this time period as a bridge between '80s Hellraiser and the modern era, while also ensuring there wouldn't be any "super high-techy stuff" to distract players. "We still wanted it to feel like an older franchise, but just without going all the way back to the '80s," de Fault added.
Pinhead has an agenda

Like most Hellraiser movies, Revival revolves around a pair of sex freaks who get more than they bargained for when they use one of the infamous puzzle boxes created by the Cenobites--the all-new Genesis Configuration in this instance. Playing as Aiden, it'll be up to players to rescue his girlfriend Sunny from the Cenobites, and you can expect to run into Pinhead at several points in the story.

"He plays a really substantial role," de Fault explained. He appears near the start of the game with all the other Cenobites, responding to the fact that Aiden and his girlfriend, Sunny, have used one of the configuration boxes from the game during their sexual play. In Hellraiser fashion, [the Cenobites] demand a soul, and they take somebody away who happens to be Sunny. "I probably shouldn't go further than that, but Pinhead, you encounter him multiple times. The deal that you have with him has its twists and turns, and it evolves."
Pinhead is also voiced by Doug Bradley, the actor who played him in several Hellraiser movies over the decades.
The "Genesis Configuration" box is fueled by suffering

While previous Hellraiser media revolved around the Lament Configuration puzzle box, the Genesis Configuration is a completely new creation for the game. It serves as both a plot device and a weapon, but to use it, you'll need to fuel it with the suffering of enemies and Aiden's own anguish. Saber Interactive isn't spilling the beans on how it fits into the overall story of Hellraiser: Revival, but they did tease that it was made for a specific purpose that will be revealed eventually.

"It's all in the name of this glorified violence, and basically, it gets powered by the suffering of yours and others," game director Emil Esov explained. "When there is suffering in the vicinity, you get more energy into the box, and you can perform these abilities."
Cenobites can't be trusted

Don't expect to be taking on iconic Cenobites in Hellraiser: Revival. They serve a variety of roles in the game, helping Aiden to unlock new powers for the Genesis Configuration or acting as unstoppable antagonists you'll have to escape. The female Cenobite--sometimes referred to as the Fallen because she was a nun who was drawn to sin in her human life--will also serve as a devil on Aiden's shoulder when she's not unlocking new powers for the Genesis Configuration.

content.v: 由 Coin Crew Games 开发、iam8bit Presents 发行的合作解谜游戏《逃脱学院2：再返校园》（Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School）公开了更多游戏内容。随着最新试玩版本在德国科隆展的开放，玩家现在得以进一步了解游戏前两个章节的冒险，并首次深入此前尚未展示的科学校区。
作为获奖解谜游戏《逃脱学院》的正统续作，《逃脱学院2：再返校园》并不满足于简单地增加更多密室，而是将系列原有的密室逃脱玩法扩展至一座可以自由探索的巨大校园，试图打造一款真正意义上的“开放世界密室逃脱游戏”。
前作已经吸引超过400万名玩家体验，而这一次，无论是第一次入学的新生，还是准备“再返校园”的老同学，都将面对一所规模更大、秘密更多，也更加危险的逃脱学院。
如需了解更多关于游戏的资讯和福利，欢迎加入逃脱学院2：再返校园的官方QQ群：2163072443
第二章首次公开：前往科学校区！
完成校园中的一系列任务后，游戏将正式进入第二章。这一次，玩家需要前往学院的科学校区，并在那里与一位全新角色——Von Bellini教授会合。
科学校区的前期内容包含两个入门级谜题房间，而目前可以公开展示的内容已经覆盖至化学实验室谜题完成。顾名思义，这一次的“课程”将把科学实验与密室解谜结合起来。
观察环境、寻找线索、理解机关之间的联系，再利用手边能够找到的一切想办法解决问题——虽然校园变得更加开放，但系列最核心的“密室逃脱感”并没有消失，而是被进一步融入了不同学院、课程和校园环境之中。至于化学实验室之后还会发生什么？为了避免剧透，我们还是把答案留到正式上课之后吧。
https://image.gcores.com/526e9e51efbc57e0d56c862f90f2cdc1-1268-714.jpeg
科学之外还有艺术！欢迎来到艺术校区
除了目前试玩能够接触到的内容，开发团队近期还通过开发日志进一步展示了另一片极具特色的区域——艺术校区。与科学校区截然不同，艺术校区在视觉设计上大量参考了西班牙建筑风格。
彩色灰泥墙、陶土瓦片、铁艺阳台与栏杆、手绘招牌以及砖石路面共同构成了整个区域，而随处可见的颜料飞溅痕迹、壁画、涂鸦与雕塑，则不断提醒玩家：这里教授的，是逃脱的“艺术”。
整个艺术校区沿着陡峭的山坡与海岸悬崖层层向下展开。山顶坐落着Hall of Escapists与Workshop，层叠式阶梯一路向下延伸，将一个个工作室与教室连接起来，形成了一座依山而建的小型艺术村落。
其中一些值得关注的地点包括：
The Monument of Escape
服装店
舞蹈工作室
剧院
当然，开发团队目前还没有准备让我们看清这些建筑内部究竟藏着什么。
https://image.gcores.com/d1ad493b120f6d825d2a8a69a152e90a-1268-714.jpeg
一位有点吓人的艺术教授
负责艺术校区大部分课程的是 Enora Chortkoff教授。而“严格”，可能都是一个比较温和的形容。Enora年轻时曾被The Showman's Studio的一场演出深深吸引，并从此梦想着有一天能够亲自站上那个舞台。
她开始把几乎所有业余时间投入到表演艺术中——看戏、写剧本，并不断训练自己掌握的各种表演技巧。《逃脱学院2：再返校园》的故事发生在她人生最大失败的10年之后。当年，Enora终于获得机会，在Jacob Surovskey著名的谋杀悬疑剧《The Death of the Artist》中饰演Ruby LeClue。然而，她过于执着于让自己的表演达到“完美”，反而忘记了真正重要的事情：把它演好。
那次失败让她再也不敢站在观众面前。后来，Solange向她伸出了手，邀请她来到逃脱学院，成为这里的表演艺术教授。于是如今的学生们，也终于有机会亲自感受Enora教授对于“艺术”的严格要求。
https://image.gcores.com/6fbeba0d748328254d66fdc9feec4054-1268-714.jpeg
一个人动脑，还是两个人一起“坐牢”？
和前作一样，《逃脱学院2：再返校园》依然可以完整单人游玩，但合作体验也是本作的重要组成部分。游戏全部内容均支持在线双人合作以及本地分屏合作，玩家可以叫上一名同学共同探索校园、交换自己发现的线索，并一起挑战各种精心设计的逃脱房间。
对于不喜欢在倒计时压力下解谜的玩家，本作还加入了全新的可选“无计时模式”。不管是经验丰富的解谜高手，还是第一次接触密室逃脱的新生，都可以选择适合自己的节奏完成课程。
与此同时，初代负责音乐的 DJ Doseone 也将回归，为这场校园生活带来一系列全新的音乐。《逃脱学院2：再返校园》将登陆 PC、Xbox Series X|S与Xbox One 平台。游戏试玩版目前已可在Steam体验。

news.title: 心理生存恐怖游戏《Holstin》确定2027年登陆PC及主机
news.summary: Team17与开发商Sonka今日宣布，备受期待的心理生存恐怖游戏 《Holstin》 将于 2027年登陆PC及主机平台，并将在发售首日加入Xbox Game Pass 。 <内嵌内容，请前往机核查看> 游戏故事发生在

content.v: Team17与开发商Sonka今日宣布，备受期待的心理生存恐怖游戏 《Holstin》 将于2027年登陆PC及主机平台，并将在发售首日加入Xbox Game Pass。
游戏故事发生在20世纪90年代初，一座与世隔绝、正在逐渐腐朽的波兰小镇遭到某种未知且不可见的恐怖力量侵蚀。《Holstin》将经典生存恐怖游戏的独特氛围与极具辨识度的背景设定和美术风格相结合，为玩家呈现一场阴暗而诡异的生存之旅。
https://image.gcores.com/c051157de9ed9f00d9ea307c0c84b5d0-1268-714.jpeg
独特2XD渲染技术，在像素世界中自由切换视角
《Holstin》采用Sonka自主研发的 2XD Rendering技术，通过实时光照和动态镜头视角，让这个阴森诡异的像素世界真正“活”起来。
玩家可以在8个不同角度之间旋转镜头，探索Jeziorne-Kolonia小镇每一个被黏液覆盖的角落，并根据不同场景无缝切换游戏视角。
游戏包含多种截然不同的表现方式，包括：
等距3D视角
激烈战斗中的越肩视角
驾驶车辆时的第一人称视角
俯视角探索
横版平台动作
多种视角和玩法形式相互结合，创造出在像素风格游戏中极为少见的视觉体验。
深入被诅咒的波兰小镇，寻找失踪的好友
游戏讲述了主人公 Tomasz Wolanski 的故事。
为了寻找自己失踪的好友，他来到坐落于湖畔乡间的小镇 Jeziorne-Kolonia。他的好友是一名调查记者，最后一次被人看到正是在这里。
然而，当Tomasz真正踏入小镇后，他很快发现这里已经被某种难以名状的恐怖力量所笼罩。
想要从游荡在被诅咒小镇中的怪物手下活下来，玩家必须不断搜寻武器、补给以及任何可能帮助Tomasz生存下去的物资。
怪物却并不是这里唯一的危险。
小镇中为数不多的幸存居民也在逐渐失去理智。玩家需要顺着他们越来越严重的妄想与其交流。如果能够获得这些居民的信任，他们或许会提供重要线索以及解开谜题所需要的信息。
但想要揭开他们隐藏的秘密，则需要玩家更加谨慎、机敏地与他们周旋。
https://image.gcores.com/65c15f0d3edf1e6dafe6f1557f7019f6-1268-714.jpeg
重现90年代后苏联时代东欧风貌
《Holstin》致力于还原20世纪90年代后苏联时代东欧地区的独特面貌与氛围，其中尤其聚焦于波兰。
从Jeziorne-Kolonia小镇中的家具和日常用品，到商品品牌、标识、建筑与室内设计，每一个细节都经过精心设计，以重现那个时代。
褪色的墙纸、破旧的家用电器、年代久远的广告以及随处可见的日常用品共同构成了这个世界，让玩家即使观察最微小的角落，也能够感受到浓郁的时代气息。
与此同时，游戏将提供完整的波兰语及英语配音，玩家可以选择自己喜欢的语言体验这个陌生而又令人不安的世界。
波兰另类摇滚乐队Heima打造原声音乐
《Holstin》诡异压抑的氛围还将通过专门为游戏创作的音乐进一步得到强化。
游戏原声由波兰另类摇滚乐队Heima负责创作，在阴森诡异之余又带有令人平静的独特气质，并包含完整的波兰语人声演唱及歌词。
乐队近期已经发布了游戏原声中的首支单曲——《Skaza》，目前已登陆各大主流音乐流媒体平台。
Steam试玩版现已开放，94%特别好评
等不及2027年正式发售？现在就可以亲自踏入Jeziorne-Kolonia。
《Holstin》目前已经在Steam推出免费试玩版，胆量足够的玩家可以亲自体验游戏开头约两个小时的内容。
目前试玩版已经在Steam获得500多篇玩家评测，其中94%为好评，整体评价达到“特别好评”。
《Holstin》将于2027年登陆PC及主机平台，并于发售首日加入Xbox Game Pass。
